brag beaver.name: Brag Beaver
brag beaver.origin: Brag Beaver was the leader of a gang out outlaws during the days of the American Frontier. While he and his men rode through the outskirts of Caliber City, Texas, they rode through Hidden Valley and caught Lance Temple as he was maintaining his Texas Kid costume. Knocking Lance out, Brag realized that they discovered the true identity of the Texas Kid. Brag then came up with a plot to pose as the Texas Kid and rob the town. Attempts to ride Lance's horse Thunder failed and Lane was left tied to a tree while rattle snakes were smoked out of a nearby cave to bite him. Brag and his men robbed Caliber City while posing as the Texas Kid, forcing the locals to treat their long time protector as an outlaw. Lance managed to break free and track down Brag and his gang. Catching Brag alone, Lance knocked him out and took back his costume. As the Texas Kid Lance gunned down Brag and his men. Later, the Texas Kid returned the stolen loot, telling the locals that the whole ordeal was a lesson to teach them that they had become too reliant of him to defend them.
weapons: Brag carried six-guns.

bragi country of the worm.name: Bragi (Country of the Worm)
bragi country of the worm.origin: Bragi was an Aesir of Niord's tribe, and his brother-in-arms, who migrated southwards, into the Country of the Worm. When they entered it, Bragi was among those who heared the toms-toms of the Picts. In the morning, the Aesir clashed with the Picts and defeated them. During the battle, Niord spared the Pict Gorm, who later helped Picts and Aesir to make peace. While Niord was recovering for months from wounds inflicted during a hunting party, a peaceful secession occurred, as Bragi and forty-five young men and their women departed into to Valley of Broken Stones, despite the Picts' warning about demons. His embryonic clan established themselves into an ancient temple, but was wiped out by the Worm feared by the Picts. Gorm (who had heard the screams of the Aesir) and Niord (who had came to visit them) built a funeral pyre for the fallen Aesir. Niord would avenge them by attacking the Worm, causing both its and his own ends.
weapons: Sword and spear.

brain monster.name: Brain Monster
brain monster.origin: The origins of the Brain Monster are unknown, and it is a resident of the planet Autan. A massive brain needing to eat gold, it somehow forced the local Autanians to mine for the material it needed to eat. It also developed an army of Cube Men, robots that were an extension of its own powerful mind. By 1949, the Autanians, led by a man named Grail, revolted against the Brain Monster and refused to mine for gold. The Brain Monster then sent its Cube Men to Earth to collect gold from that planet. There the Cube Men brought back Sun Girl to present to their master because locals referred to her as the "Golden Goddess". The Brain Monster told Sun Girl that it intended to eliminate the Autanians and harvest gold from Earth instead, but Sun Girl convinced the creature to let her talk to Grail and his people. Sun Girl has convinced Grail to feign subservience to the Brain Monster, and when the creature was distracted Sun Girl loosened her bonds and fired her sun beam directly into the Brain Monster's massive brain. The effect killed the Brain Monster and deactivated its Cube Men, ending the creatures threat.
powers: Technopathy: The Brain Monster has a powerful intellect that allow it to transmit its will into machines, in particular his Cube Men. The monster did not appear to have any other extra-cognitive abilities.
weaknesses: The Brain Monster was mostly immobile making it an easy target. It also relied on gold as its only form of sustenance.

brainstorm jimmy.name: Brainstorm (Jimmy)
brainstorm jimmy.origin: When Doctor Hope was sent to City Hospital, Brainstorm and several of the other Mad Dogs were transferred there as well, and Hope continued his experiments on them. Hope initiated a new process of experimentation, by which he thought to bring out the primitive, reptilian part of the brain, which he saw as having greater potential then the human mind. Brainstorm underwent this process and mutated dramatically. Soon after, the new heads of the Mad Dog Ward came under fire from the investigation of reporter Maggie Lorca. The administrators forced Hope to send Brainstorm out to capture and silence Lorca by whatever means possible. Lorca was working with photographer Peter Parker, and so Spider-Man defended her from Brainstorm. Brainstorm's new mental powers enabled him to get the better of Spider-Man, and he left him trapped within rapidly hardening cement. Captain Zero, also a former inmate at Pleasant Valley, located Brainstorm and stopped him from killing Lorca. Zero managed to occupy him long enough for Spider-Man to free himself. After some struggle, Zero hurled soapy water in Brainstorm's eyes, distracting him and allowing Spidey to drop him with a double ear clap. Brainstorm recovered almost immediately, but he decided to take a rest on the city's tab and bust out once he was ready.
weaknesses: Brainstorm is violently insane and will go on an uncontrollable rampage.

fields.unusual_features: In reptilian form, he had green skin, claws, and a row of ridges running down his back.

brak.name: Brak
brak.origin: Brak the Barbarian was hired by an unnamed village to fight off a Dragon-Thing in the Dead Place. To assist in this task he visited a witch named Valena who offered to enchant his blade in exchange for gold, but told him that it would also leave the barbarian cursed for a short time to attack the first other he sees within the hour of slaying the dragon. Brak ventured to the Dead Place and slew the dragon, but was startled by a young woman named Jonel who was sent by the witch to see to Brak's nonexistent wounds. Thankfully due to the sun in the Barbarian's eyes he did not seethe young woman and instead reached out for her sash and bound his eyes. Together the two ventured back to the witch cloth still covering his eyes. Valena questioned if the Barbarian had been injured during the fight but he denied it and explained to her what transpired. It was there that Brak declared to the witch her betrayal over petty jealousy of Jonel's beauty and so he moved in for the kill. Valena attempted to call forth her magic to slay the barbarian but Brak was too swift and slew her. Upon exiting the hut of the witch he posed the question if her magic had helped him kill the dragon or if it was him alone who accomplished the task.
weapons: Broadsword

bramer.name: Bramer
bramer.origin: Bramer was the leader of the Cell 12. He spied on and followed Peter and Mary Jane movements, before ambushing them in the right place. He led the punishing operation, following his own will and not listening to Lasher and Andros' comments. He let Peter Parker go only after he had been badly beaten. Despite Bramer's orders, Lasher attacked Spider-Man alone, ruining the ambush at the Multivex Corporation. Bramer could only intervene after Spider-Man had stopped his men. He tried to shoot Spider-Man, but was easily knocked out by a single punch. The day after they captured Peter Parker again. Bramer was killing Parker, but Spider-Man webbed him and pulling him to smash on some machinery, knocking him down. Some days later, seriously wounded, he and his men asked Hobgoblin for their payment, but he claimed they had failed the mission and rewarded them with a Pumpkin Bombs.
powers: He was cybernetically empowered, and his left arm had a sort of ray cannon. He could speak to the others without any apparent external communication device, and the others could trace his position.

bran braddock.name: Bran Braddock
bran braddock.origin: Bran Braddock is a superhuman from Earth-2122, who is sworn to protect and uphold the laws of the British Empire. He spies military helicopters converging on Euston station. W.H.O is already on the scene, with Alistaire Stuart as the Brigadier in this reality, and his sister Alysande the scientific advisor. A mysterious train has arrived on the platform, with no passengers and a wrecked interior. On board however, Dai Thomas finds a picture of Nightcrawler, who he knows as one of Prussia's spies. To protect the Queen's summit of the World's powers, Crusader X sets off on the trail. He finds Earth-616's Nightcrawler on a rooftop, and tries to grab him, but is stopped by Rachel Summers wielding the Phoenix Force. When she is distracted and flies off after Earth-2122's Jean Grey, Crusader X swings into action. He and Nightcrawler duel on the rooftop until Crusader X finally captures him. He puts Nightcrawler under arrest for spying against the Empire, and flies off into the night. The next day, Crusader X converges on the X-mansion, along with Archangel. He finds all the mutants at the Mansion, psychic or not, have been injured to varying degrees, up to Lady Moira MacTaggert and Lord Charles Xavier, who are catatonic from the psychic blast. With Jean Grey, mutant liaison for the Summit missing, Crusader X goes to track her down. During his search, he finds Captain Britain trying to free Nightcrawler from the Tower of London. They fight but are evenly matched, and so the fight goes on and on. Eventually, Lockheed draws the attentions of both Bran Braddocks to Iron Man, who is attacking the summit of the world's monarchs. They defeat him, but when they follow the trail back to the Hellfire Club, it's empty. He was part of the reformed Captain Britain Corps summoned to the Starlight Citadel when it was besieged by daemons from Amenth and helped hold the line along with the X-Men.
powers: Interdimensional Energy Conduit: His abilities are powered by interdimensional energies which are concentrated around the British Isles of each reality and also in Otherworld
abilities: Experienced Fighter: Crusader X can use his ball and chain in battle with great skill.
weapons: Ball and Chain: Crusader X uses in battle a studded ball and chain.

bran carter.name: Bran Carter
bran carter.origin: thumb|left|142px|Bran Carter Bran Kunze was a German citizen who immigrated to the United States prior to World War II. Legally changing his last name to Carter, he eventually became the supervisor of a wartime manufacturing plant by 1944. Maintaining loyalties to the Nazis, he created the costumed identity of Madame X to conceal his spy activities. With his minions, he called all an invitation to all the female workers at the munitions plants as Madame X where "she" demanded that they assist in stealing defense plans and destroying the factories for the Nazis. When one of Carter's employees, Eva Barry, refused to participate, Madame X strangled her to death as a warning to the others and disappeared. Unknown to Carter at the time was that Eva's sister Lorraine learned Madame X's true identity. The following day, Carter was called into police headquarters for questioning but provided the authorities with no information. There, he met the Human Torch and Toro who were called in to investigate the case and was present when Lorraine called in her tip and asked the Torch to meet her at Riverside Park. Carter then slipped away and as Madame X, got to Riverside Park before the Torch and Toro and strangled Lorraine to death as well, and managed to evade the two heroes. Having called another meeting with the factory workers, Madame X ordered them to "her" bidding or risk their family members being killed in response. Just then, the Torch and Toro (finding an invitation on Lorraine's body) burst in and attempted to round up Madame X and her men. Madame X managed to escape, landing a punch in the Torch's jaw and leaving the mark of "her" insignia ring on his face. Spotting Madame X fleeing into the factory, the Torch and Toro followed after her and ran into Carter, who had just slipped out of his costume. Unfazed by the heroes' appearance, Carter told them that he "saw" Madame X escape in a getaway car before shaking hands with the Torch. The Torch then noticed that Carter and Madame X wore the same exact ring, prompting the hero to investigate Carter's background. Suspecting that the Torch might have deduced his double identity, Carter prepared a trap for the Torch and Toro at his home. When the Torch and Toro arrived to investigate the property, they were then captured by Madame X who placed them in a refrigerated glass coffin to freeze to death. Going back to the meeting hall, Madame X then began handing out bombs to the workers to place in the boiler rooms of their respective places of employments, not telling them that the bombs were set to go off earlier than scheduled to kill the women as well. Before the women could leave, the Torch and Toro then arrived -- having freed themselves from Madame X's trap -- and subdued Madame X and her gang, revealing her to be Bran Carter in disguise.
weapons: Bran had access to fire arms, explosives, and used a large coffin shape freezer made of glass as a trap.

bran mak morn.name: Bran Mak Morn
bran mak morn.origin: ===Origin=== Bran Mak Morn was the descendant of Brule the Spear-Slayer, the Pictish companion of Pre-Cataclysmic Age king Kull, the first of line of the Mak Morn. He resembled his ancestor. In his race of savages, he was possibly an atavism, a throwback to the original Picts that ruled all Europe before their primitive empire was destroyed by the Gauls. He was a Caledonian Pict, son to the chief of the Wolf Clan. He had at least a sister. He inherited a iron crown set with a jewel given by Kull to Brule. The jewel allegedly brought luck to Bran Mak Morn. ===200 AD=== Circa 200 AD, Bran Mak Morn had rose on his own as the pictish king, uniting the Tribes of the Heather (though he had difficulties to have the Pictish clans to forget their blood-feuds), and claiming kingship over all Caledon. He was assisted by Gonar, the descendant of Gonar, the wizard of Kull, thought Bran Mak Morn sometimes thought he was the original Gonar himself. He rebelled against the Romans after being forced to watch one of his Picts being crucified. In his preparation against Rome, Bran Mak Morn assembled an army including Britons and their chariots that had came to him because of some dispute with their chief, and Gael Cormac of Connacht and his western horsemen. At some point, he enlisted a troop of three hundred northmen under a vow, but when their chief, Rognar, died, they refused to honor the oath and, led by Wulfhere, threatened to go over to the Romans, unless they were to be led by a king of their own race, then at least a king not Pict, Gael, nor Briton. Bran Mak Morn, the Pictish chiefs Gron and Bocah, and Cormac met over the sacrifice of a Roman captive by Gonar, who read the portents and announced victory over the Romans. Both Cormac and Bran Mak Morn were defiant of divination, but the scenery was made to galvanize Gron and Bocah, for them to rally their clans. To make the northmen fulfil their oath, Gonar decided to use the jewel, and summoned King Kull in their era, who first confused Bran for Brule, and thought to be dreaming. Wulfhere refused to have Kull, a "ghost", lead his people, and the two dueled. Kull killed Wulfhere, and the Vikings enthousiastically accepted him as their leader. ===Modern Age=== Circa 1932, Robert Howard had wrote stories about Bran Mak Morn.

brander.name: Brander
brander.origin: The Brander was a torture expert who worked for the Nazis during World War II. By the end of 1942, he was working under Gestapo chief Captain von Nieusance. When two men responsible for publishing an underground newspaper were captured, von Nieusance sent them down to the Brander to be tortured so that they would reveal the location of their illegal press -- completely unaware that the press was hidden beneath their very location. When the Destroyer came to rescue the men, he posed as Captain von Nieusance in order to get close enough to them. When the Brander deduced that "von Nieusance" was an impostor, he attacked the Destroyer. Unfortunately, the Brander was no match for the hero and was easily beaten into submission and burned by his own branding iron. The Destroyer and the Brander's two prisoners then managed to escape through a secret passage way. The Branders subsequent activities during the war are unknown.
weapons: The Brander's weapon of choice was a branding iron with the shape of a skull and cross bones on its branding end, which he used to torture his enemies.

brandon best.name: Brandon Best
brandon best.first_appearance: Marvel's Wastelanders: Old Man Star-Lord Season 1 4
brandon best.origin: Brandon Best had been hired by Victor von Doom to be his secretary prior to the events of V-Day. However, on V-Day, Best found Doom critically injured after an attack by the Hulk. Best took advantage, putting an inhibitor collar on Doom and locking him up in a dungeon in the compound that Doom was planning to use as his seat of government. He stole Doom's mask and cloak for himself and impersonated Doom from that day onward for the next thirty years. In addition, Best was the official voice of the government under his own identity, running a radio network based on pro-Doom propaganda and hosting the reality show "Deer on a Spear." When the Second Dawn revolution stormed Doom's compound, they captured and executed the man they thought was Doom, who was actually Brandon Best.

brandon chambers.origin: Brandon Chambers was a scientist and executive for Roxxon Energy Corporation. He recruited his brother Phillip, a better scientist expert in DNA-splicing, to work for Roxxon in a project to create ad-hoc hybrids. Brandon led the project for Roxxon, answering to a Mr. Greycrest. Phillip told Brandon that their brother Mitchell had died due to cancer, but really Phillip had used Mitchell as a test subject and turned him into a monster When the project was advanced, Brandon and Phillip decided to escape from Roxxon and sold it to more profitable, and even less ethical, underworld interests. Their plan was stopped by Spider-Man, Punisher, and Sabretooth; Sabretooth killed Phillip, but not before Phillip revealed that Mitchell had been turned into a monster. Spider-Man and the Punisher exposed the illegal operation, but Brandon captured Mitchell and offered it to Roxxon to have more funds for his own trial.

brandon forsythe.name: Brandon Forsythe
brandon forsythe.origin: Brandon Forsythe was a crooked businessman who had been responsible for ruining a number of businesses in the past. Arnold Crang knew that Forsythe had robbed him but couldn't prove it. For some unexplained reason, ruining Crang caused Forsythe's subconscious mind to feel regret or guilt over his past actions. As a result, Forsythe began experiencing a recurring dream in which he was confronted by a grey-robed figure bound in heavy chains. Although the haunting figure just stared at him, its presence made Forsythe feel terrified and he began to dread falling asleep. Desperate for help, Forsythe went to Doctor Strange who agreed to find the answer to his dream by entering it. That night, after Forsythe fell asleep and began to dream, Strange's astral spirit entered his dream and confronted the bound figure when it appeared, demanding to know what it was and why it was tormenting Forsythe. The figure revealed that Forsythe well knew the reason why because it was the symbol of the evil that Forsythe had done and that was why it was chained. The figure then told Strange that if he did not believe, he should ask Mr. Crang. At that moment, Nightmare arrived to confront Strange and Forsythe woke up. Remembering that the figure had mentioned Crang and realizing that Strange must have heard that name, Forsythe decided that Strange couldn't be allowed to live with what he had learned. After getting his gun, Forsythe prepared to shoot Strange while he was still in his trance but was stopped before he could fire by the Ancient One who remotely activated Strange's Amulet of Agamotto, causing it to emit a blinding hypnotic ray that paralyzed Forsythe long enough for Strange's astral self to escape from the Dream Dimension, reunite with his physical body and disarm Forsythe. Once freed from the hypnotic spell, Forsythe admitted that his dream had been caused by the many men he had ruined in business, the last of whom had been Crang. Forsythe then stated that he would confess and Doctor Strange told him that doing so was the only way he would ever sleep again. Forsythe did make an unsolicited confession of illegal business tactics and was convicted. This story was one of many that Strange later told to his friend Morgana Blessing. Later still, after Strange had faked his death, Morgana, who was unaware that he was still alive, felt that it was wrong that so few people knew how much her friend had done for humankind so she wrote a biography which revealed a lot of information about his past exploits, including his encounter with Forsythe.

brandy selby.name: Brandy Selby
brandy selby.species: Human who inherited the Starbrand from her mother
brandy selby.origin: Brandy was the daughter of Suzanne Selby, an unemployed pregnant worker who was recruited to work on grape harvests in the Shi'ar Galaxy with her boyfriend. Eventually, Suzanne became separated from her boyfriend and was arrested by the Shi'ar border patrol for being a migrant worker. Sometime before, Planet Earth's Starbrand, Kevin Connor, had died, and, as Suzanne was going into labor during her transportation to the Ravenstarr Maximum-Security Prison Galaxy, she became the new Starbrand, a transformation that sent her on a path of destruction while she tried to control her new destructive powers. This incident ended with the Avengers assisting the delivery of Suzanne's baby. Suzanne died in childbirth, and the Starbrand was transferred to her baby girl. The Avengers returned with the child to Earth in order to help her control her new power, and dubbed her "Brandy". thumb|left|Infant Brandy One day, Brandy found herself in an alternate reality and floating in the depths of space. She was eventually found by that reality's Rocket Raccoon and Groot, who brought her aboard their ship, the Mothership Guardian, much to Rocket's annoyance. He eventually relented, and, together, they raised Brandy. As she grew up, she learned how to use her powers and, when Rocket was hired to kill Doctor Spectrum and was losing the fight, Brandy was able to pass on her Star Brand to aid Rocket. It still wasn't enough, however, and Spectrum killed him. The Star Brand returned to Brandy, and she was left brokenhearted by Rocket's death. She then wanted to go to Earth to restore reality to its proper state and kill Spectrum, something that Groot tried to talk her out of. Suddenly, a Wakandan spaceship appeared looking for Brandy. Once on Earth, Brandy joined the Avengers. She and Avengers later confronted the Squadron Supreme when they tracked the Avengers to the hidden nation of Wakanda. thumb|right|During her Childhood Brandy fought Doctor Spectrum for killing Rocket and managed to melt his Power Prism until it was rendered useless, leaving Spectrum devastated, much to Brandy's delight. Brandy then aided her teammate Echo defeat Power Princess and destroyed the source of the reality warp, President Coulson's Pandemonium Cube. With the Pandemonium Cube's destruction, Brandy was returned to Earth-616 but retained the natural aging she underwent while she was in the other reality. thumb|left|Young adult The Avengers grew worried with Brandy as she displayed very rude behavior and lacked any manners, despite her young age. In an attempt to connect with her, Captain America and Captain Marvel took her to her mother's home in Kansas. While there, however, they were attacked by the Multiversal Masters of Evil, and Brandy saw herself unleashing her full power against them. When the dust settled, the two Avengers were speechless as Brandy had seemingly aged into a young woman. The cause of this wasn't clear, and the Avengers were more worried than ever, but she was accepted into the team to help them fight Mephisto and the Council of Red. As the Avengers were about to embark on their journey across time to battle the Mephistos, Brandy was warned by her teammates and even the dead Progenitor of Avengers Mountain about using her powers as she aged up every time she used them. She persisted, especially after briefly bonding with a prehistoric dinosaur Starbrand, but it soon reached the point that she was elderly. When the modern Avengers encountered the prehistoric Avengers, Brandy was told to stay back as she could no longer use her powers safely. She watched as the prehistoric Starbrand was killed by Doom Supreme of the Multiversal Masters of Evil and thanked his corpse for his sacrifice. thumb|Brandy and Firehair sacrificed themselves After being summoned to the God Quarry, she initially sat back in the sidelines while the others fought against Doom Supreme's army, but decided to use her powers once more. When a breach in the God Quarry threatened the entire Multiverse, Starbrand volunteered to seal it from the other side but Ghost Rider beat her to it. Nevertheless, she sacrificed herself along with Phoenix (Firehair) to undo the damage the Masters had done to the other Earths.
weaknesses: Brandy aged herself up whenever she used her powers. The Starbrand does not usually do this, so this weakness was exclusive to Brandy.

This incident ended with the Avengers assisting the delivery of Suzanne's baby. Suzanne died in childbirth, and the Starbrand was transferred to her baby girl. The Avengers returned with the child to Earth in order to help her control her new power, and dubbed her "Brandy". thumb|left|Infant Brandy One day, Brandy found herself in an alternate reality and floating in the depths of space. She was eventually found by that reality's Rocket Raccoon and Groot, who brought her aboard their ship, the Mothership Guardian, much to Rocket's annoyance. He eventually relented, and, together, they raised Brandy. As she grew up, she learned how to use her powers and, when Rocket was hired to kill Doctor Spectrum and was losing the fight, Brandy was able to pass on her Star Brand to aid Rocket. It still wasn't enough, however, and Spectrum killed him. The Star Brand returned to Brandy, and she was left brokenhearted by Rocket's death. She then wanted to go to Earth to restore reality to its proper state and kill Spectrum, something that Groot tried to talk her out of. Suddenly, a Wakandan spaceship appeared looking for Brandy. Once on Earth, Brandy joined the Avengers. She and Avengers later confronted the Squadron Supreme when they tracked the Avengers to the hidden nation of Wakanda. thumb|right|During her Childhood Brandy fought Doctor Spectrum for killing Rocket and managed to melt his Power Prism until it was rendered useless, leaving Spectrum devastated, much to Brandy's delight. Brandy then aided her teammate Echo defeat Power Princess and destroyed the source of the reality warp, President Coulson's Pandemonium Cube. With the Pandemonium Cube's destruction, Brandy was returned to Earth-616 but retained the natural aging she underwent while she was in the other reality. thumb|left|Young adult The Avengers grew worried with Brandy as she displayed very rude behavior and lacked any manners, despite her young age. In an attempt to connect with her, Captain America and Captain Marvel took her to her mother's home in Kansas. While there, however, they were attacked by the Multiversal Masters of Evil, and Brandy saw herself unleashing her full power against them. When the dust settled, the two Avengers were speechless as Brandy had seemingly aged into a young woman. The cause of this wasn't clear, and the Avengers were more worried than ever, but she was accepted into the team to help them fight Mephisto and the Council of Red. As the Avengers were about to embark on their journey across time to battle the Mephistos, Brandy was warned by her teammates and even the dead Progenitor of Avengers Mountain about using her powers as she aged up every time she used them. She persisted, especially after briefly bonding with a prehistoric dinosaur Starbrand, but it soon reached the point that she was elderly. When the modern Avengers encountered the prehistoric Avengers, Brandy was told to stay back as she could no longer use her powers safely. She watched as the prehistoric Starbrand was killed by Doom Supreme of the Multiversal Masters of Evil and thanked his corpse for his sacrifice. thumb|Brandy and Firehair sacrificed themselves After being summoned to the God Quarry, she initially sat back in the sidelines while the others fought against Doom Supreme's army, but decided to use her powers once more. When a breach in the God Quarry threatened the entire Multiverse, Starbrand volunteered to seal it from the other side but Ghost Rider beat her to it. Nevertheless, she sacrificed herself along with Phoenix (Firehair) to undo the damage the Masters had done to the other Earths.
weaknesses: Brandy aged herself up whenever she used her powers. The Starbrand does not usually do this, so this weakness was exclusive to Brandy.
fields.notes: When Brandy's mother was detained for being an illegal alien, Brandy (still unborn) was sentenced to 2 years in prison, pending birth.
fields.species: Human who inherited the Starbrand from her mother

branwen.origin: ===Origins=== Branwen was born in the Kingdom of Gwynedd, located in what is now modern-day Wales. She was the daughter of the storm god Leir and Penarddun, the daugther of Beli Mawr. ===Legacy=== Upon reaching adulthood, Branwen's brother, Bran, was crowned king of Britain. In an effort to forge an alliance, Bran agreed to arrange Branwen's marriage to King Matholwch of Ireland. However, the union soon turned tragic. Branwen faced mistreatment at the hands of her husband, prompting her brother to take action. Bran led an army across the Irish Sea to rescue her, sparking a devastating conflict. The war resulted in the deaths of both Matholwch and Bran, the latter of whom was beheaded.

breathtaker.origin: One of the Draumar, servants of the Serpent, Breathtaker has served the Serpent for millennia, originally present when Odin led his original assault on the Serpent's citadel, a battle that led to Breathtaker's death. Consigned to the afterlife, Breathtaker and the rest of the Draumar arose in the modern day following the Serpent's release from his prison. Assaulting Hel and destroying the deceased Asgardians present, the Draumar were briefly halted by the arrival of Dani Moonstar, briefly granted Valkyrie powers by Hela. Breathtaker and the other Draumar were destroyed when Hela extracted from Nate Grey's mind all of his past in her universe, and the Draumar being too ancient to comprehend all that had transpired during the aeons outside of Hel, fear of the unknown overtook that of their leader , the Serpent, apparently disintegrating them.

brell.origin: Brell was once a member of the Vassyr Liberation Army, an army of cyborgs called the Enhanced which engaged in a ceaseless war against the mystical Cynodd. While the Vassyr Liberation Army was seemingly victorious, the Cynodd survived and disabled Brell's ship while he was in cryostasis. Centuries later, Brell's ship managed to regain power and ejected him onto the nearest habitable planet: Earth. Amnesiac, he landed near Las Vegas and was found by Gale Patric, who let him stay at her bar the Blue Chip Casino. After making a scene, Brell was identified by a rival casino that served as a front for the Cynodd's kidnapping operation. He regained his memories just in time to stop them from killing him and Gale. With the help of Johnny Blaze and Dan Ketch, Brell was able to defeat the Cynodd and free their captives, stealing a Cynodd spaceship to return to the stars.

bremusa.name: Bremusa
bremusa.origin: Bremusa was one of the Amazons living in Themiscyra, on the Thermodon River, in Anatolia. Along with eleven other fellow Amazons Polemusa, Derinoè, Evandrè, Antandrè, Clonié, Hippothoè, Harmothoè, Alcibiè, Derimacheia, Antibrotè and Thermodosa, Bremusa accompanied Penthesilea who went to Troy in the last years of the Trojan War in order to cleanse her soul after the accidental murder of her sister and queen Hippolyta. The Amazons were acclaimed by the crowd and welcomed by King Priam and his family. There, Penthesilea swore that she and her Amazons would kill Achilles and repel the Argives back to their coasts, despite the accusation of arrogance from Andromache, widow of Hector whom Achilles had slain. The next day, they went to battle as the vanguard of the Trojans who were galvanized by Penthesilea. Priam prayed for help to Zeus, but saw an eagle grasping a dove and interpreted it as the fact Penthesileia would not return alive. Thersites alarmed the Argives, and they met the Trojans in the battlefield. There, Bremusa was killed by Idomeneus, warrior-king of Crete. Witnessing the death of her Amazons, Penthesilea entered a fury, and was herself eventually killed by Achilles. Bremusa and the other Amazons were buried beside Penthesilea.
weapons: Spear.

brenda hale.name: Brenda Hale
brenda hale.origin: Brenda Hale is a member of the Space Army, Women's Division, 7th Regiment, in the distant future of Reality-5464. In her first recorded appearance, Brenda was dispatched on a mission to warn the Interplanetary Secret Service (ISS) about a Martian plot to invade Earth. Before she could complete her mission, her ship was attacked by Martian destroyers, forcing it to crash-land on Venus. There, she was rescued from the wreckage by Whirlwind Carter. Brenda revealed to Carter that the Martians planned to conquer Earth by deporting its population into space inside rockets, leaving the planet free for occupation. Working together, Brenda and Carter mobilized the rescued Earthlings and launched a counter-offensive. Brenda and Whirlwind would succeed in driving off the Martian forces from Earth. Later, Brenda would join Whirlwind in fending off another attack on Earth by the Black Light Men who were attempting to wipe out the human race and sell the planet to the Martians. During the fight on the Black Light Planet, Brenda would learn the Black Light People's Achilles heel: Fire. With this knowledge in hand, Brenda, Whirlwind and the ISS force would defeat the Black Light People and save the Earth once more. Brenda's subsequent activities are unknown.
abilities: Brenda is a capable fighter, and rocket pilot
weapons: At times Brenda has employed a ray gun.

brenda swanson.first_appearance: Iron Fist: The Living Weapon Vol 1 1
brenda swanson.origin: ===Origins=== Brenda is the illegitimate daughter of Harold Meachum to a cleaner with whom he was having an affair. When her mother came to Harold and told him she was pregnant, she tore up the check she was given, confident that he would change his mind about staying with her when Brenda was born. When he met Brenda, he promised to leave his own family for them as soon as he returned from a trip to the Himalayas with his business partner, but when he returned from the trip months later, he had changed his mind, and Brenda and her mother never heard from him again. When Harold eventually died, Brenda's mother died two days later, and Brenda swore vengeance on the family that had changed Harold on that trip, using the entirety of the small fortune her father had left her to train to fight and kill. When the money ran out, she enlisted to fight in Syria, discovering that the skills she desired could only be learned in active combat. ===Meeting Iron Fist=== After years of meticulous planning, she finally decided it was time for her to avenge her father by killing the last remaining member of the Rand family, the current Iron Fist. Posing as a journalist, she got an interview with him and was prepared to kill him, when she realized she had developed feelings for him and was unable to pull the trigger. She decided that killing him would not be enough to avenge her father, and instead decided to stick around and make him fall in love with her. She stuck with Danny throughout his conflict with the One, taking an injured Pei to the hospital. When they were pursued by a spider creature sent by Davos, Pei meant to face the creature, but Brenda attacked it instead, while Pei ran away. After the One's plan to resurrect Heather Rand's soul resulted in the accidental summoning of the Xian god Zhu Rong, Brenda witnessed Danny shooting himself through Zhu Rong's head to defeat him. ===Truth Revealed=== Three months later, Brenda and Danny were still dating, and Pei, who had gained the power of the Iron Fist, was living with and being trained by Danny. When he asked Brenda to move in with him over dinner, Brenda mentioned the unfinished interview from when they first met, and attacked him, stating that when she starts something, she finishes it, no matter the cost. As they fought, Danny revealed he had fallen in love with her, prompting Brenda to share her story with him. In the end, realizing she still couldn't bring herself to kill him, she tried to shoot herself in the head to force him to have to watch someone he loves die, but he managed to stop the bullet from hitting her. After their devastating date, she left. ===Immortal Iron Fists=== Sometime after leaving Danny, Brenda was captured and placed in the pits of Kamaloka, where she was forced to fight and kill demonic monsters. During one of her fights, she was reunited with Pei who, along with Jayce Paz, was taken to the pits by Mara and his daughters. She slayed a demon who was about to attack Pei and Jayce. When the Mother-of-Shou-Lao-Dragons attacked the pits to kill Pei, Brenda aided her while protecting the dead Jayce's body, who the dragon had killed. After Pei defeated the dragon, Brenda comforted the girl over the loss of her friend, but watched as Pei healed and resurrected Jayce with a kiss. When Danny managed to bring Pei and Jayce back to Earth, Brenda returned as well, along with the Mother-of-Shou-Lao-Dragons. She had a small conversation with Danny before jumping on the dragon's back and flew off to parts unknown. ===Heart of the Dragon=== Still seeking vengeance on Danny, Brenda was approached by the being known as the Hierophant who offered to give her chi powers to achieve her revenge on Iron Fist, if she collected the hearts of dragons of the Heavenly Cities. Brenda agreed and began to kill dragons and claim their hearts, giving herself the moniker Yama Dragonsbane. When a dragon was spotted in Wakanda, Brenda arrived and slayed it, claiming its heart. She manage to escape while killing a group of Hatut Zeraze soldiers who tried to stop her. She returned to the Hierophant's lair and offered the hearts of the dragons to her master who gave her Chi powers. Once the Hierophant had enough power, she joined him to march to the Heart of Heaven. Once they arrived, they encountered Iron Fist and his allies. She murdered the Goddess Quan Yin and tried to finish off the heroes, but was knocked out by Luke Cage. The Hierophant recovered her and brought her with him to pursue Fooh, who attempted to finish them off with a powerful explosive. Fooh's attack failed as the Hierophant used his acquired dragon chi to protect himself and Brenda from the explosion. The two took a portal to the Eighth City to finish off the heroes and claim the remaining dragon hearts. When the Hierophant and Okoye clashed using their respective dragon chi powers, Brenda attempted to help her master but was caught in the resulting chi explosion which killed the Hierophant and released t

When her mother came to Harold and told him she was pregnant, she tore up the check she was given, confident that he would change his mind about staying with her when Brenda was born. When he met Brenda, he promised to leave his own family for them as soon as he returned from a trip to the Himalayas with his business partner, but when he returned from the trip months later, he had changed his mind, and Brenda and her mother never heard from him again. When Harold eventually died, Brenda's mother died two days later, and Brenda swore vengeance on the family that had changed Harold on that trip, using the entirety of the small fortune her father had left her to train to fight and kill. When the money ran out, she enlisted to fight in Syria, discovering that the skills she desired could only be learned in active combat. ===Meeting Iron Fist=== After years of meticulous planning, she finally decided it was time for her to avenge her father by killing the last remaining member of the Rand family, the current Iron Fist. Posing as a journalist, she got an interview with him and was prepared to kill him, when she realized she had developed feelings for him and was unable to pull the trigger. She decided that killing him would not be enough to avenge her father, and instead decided to stick around and make him fall in love with her. She stuck with Danny throughout his conflict with the One, taking an injured Pei to the hospital. When they were pursued by a spider creature sent by Davos, Pei meant to face the creature, but Brenda attacked it instead, while Pei ran away. After the One's plan to resurrect Heather Rand's soul resulted in the accidental summoning of the Xian god Zhu Rong, Brenda witnessed Danny shooting himself through Zhu Rong's head to defeat him. ===Truth Revealed=== Three months later, Brenda and Danny were still dating, and Pei, who had gained the power of the Iron Fist, was living with and being trained by Danny. When he asked Brenda to move in with him over dinner, Brenda mentioned the unfinished interview from when they first met, and attacked him, stating that when she starts something, she finishes it, no matter the cost. As they fought, Danny revealed he had fallen in love with her, prompting Brenda to share her story with him. In the end, realizing she still couldn't bring herself to kill him, she tried to shoot herself in the head to force him to have to watch someone he loves die, but he managed to stop the bullet from hitting her. After their devastating date, she left. ===Immortal Iron Fists=== Sometime after leaving Danny, Brenda was captured and placed in the pits of Kamaloka, where she was forced to fight and kill demonic monsters. During one of her fights, she was reunited with Pei who, along with Jayce Paz, was taken to the pits by Mara and his daughters. She slayed a demon who was about to attack Pei and Jayce. When the Mother-of-Shou-Lao-Dragons attacked the pits to kill Pei, Brenda aided her while protecting the dead Jayce's body, who the dragon had killed. After Pei defeated the dragon, Brenda comforted the girl over the loss of her friend, but watched as Pei healed and resurrected Jayce with a kiss. When Danny managed to bring Pei and Jayce back to Earth, Brenda returned as well, along with the Mother-of-Shou-Lao-Dragons. She had a small conversation with Danny before jumping on the dragon's back and flew off to parts unknown. ===Heart of the Dragon=== Still seeking vengeance on Danny, Brenda was approached by the being known as the Hierophant who offered to give her chi powers to achieve her revenge on Iron Fist, if she collected the hearts of dragons of the Heavenly Cities. Brenda agreed and began to kill dragons and claim their hearts, giving herself the moniker Yama Dragonsbane. When a dragon was spotted in Wakanda, Brenda arrived and slayed it, claiming its heart. She manage to escape while killing a group of Hatut Zeraze soldiers who tried to stop her. She returned to the Hierophant's lair and offered the hearts of the dragons to her master who gave her Chi powers. Once the Hierophant had enough power, she joined him to march to the Heart of Heaven. Once they arrived, they encountered Iron Fist and his allies. She murdered the Goddess Quan Yin and tried to finish off the heroes, but was knocked out by Luke Cage. The Hierophant recovered her and brought her with him to pursue Fooh, who attempted to finish them off with a powerful explosive. Fooh's attack failed as the Hierophant used his acquired dragon chi to protect himself and Brenda from the explosion. The two took a portal to the Eighth City to finish off the heroes and claim the remaining dragon hearts. brent langrock.name: Brent Langrock
brent langrock.origin: Brent Langrock was the son of Joseph Langrock, whose family was the richest in the Alaskan town of Burns, and an avid hunter. His mother had died giving birth to his younger brother Hudson, which caused both Brent and his father to resent and abuse Hudson well into his adulthood. Eventually deciding to end his life, Hudson attempted to overdose on their own drug supply by consuming a lethal dose of fentanyl. However instead of dying, Hudson awoke naked and covered in blood and discovered that he was reborn as a Wendigo. He began taking revenge on his family by first killing all of Brent's past girlfriends, then killing Brent himself, and finally exacting revenge on his father.

bres.name: Bres
bres.origin: ===Origins=== left|thumb|Bres the Beautiful Bres was the son of Elathan, a Fomorian prince, and Ériu, a member of the Tuatha de Danaan, two groups that had been in conflict for millennia. Revered as the god of mischief and fertility, his mother concealed his Fomorian parentage from the Tuatha people. ===Reign over the Tuatha=== thumb|Ever scheming Around 1896 BC, when the Tuatha de Danaan migrated from Otherworld to Earth and settled in Ireland, Bres’ uncle, Nuada, the Tuatha ruler, suffered a severe injury in the First Battle of Mag Tuired and was forced to step down. In the wake of Nuada’s abdication, Bres was chosen as his successor. However, his rule soon became marked by oppression and corruption, leading to growing dissatisfaction among the Tuatha. After seven years, Bres was deposed, an outcome largely driven by the efforts of Caber, his most vocal critic. ===Fomorian Downfall=== thumb|left|Retreating to the Dark Realm Upon his deposition, Bres learned of his Fomorian lineage from his mother, Ériu. Seeking refuge, he fled to the Island of the Tower of Glass, now known as Tory Island off the coast of Donegal, Ireland. There, he reunited with his biological father, Elathan, and persuaded the Fomorians to launch an assault on the Tuatha de Danaan. This conflict culminated in the Second Battle of Mag Tuired, where the Fomorians were decisively defeated and driven back to their Dark Realm in Otherworld. Bres was captured by the sun god Lugh, but his life was spared on the condition that he teach the Celts the art of agriculture. ===12th Century=== thumb|Facing the Black Knight Centuries later, in the 12th century AD, the Fomorians launched an attack on Avalon, the mystical isle of Otherworld. Amergin Glúingel, Avalon’s High Druid, summoned the Avengers of the modern era through his descendant, Doctor Druid. Bres, foreseeing the Fomorians’ inevitable defeat, prophesied a favorable outcome for his people while secretly plotting for his own benefit. During the ensuing battle, Bres bypassed the Avengers, attacked the Black Knight, and accessed a portal to the modern era created by Amergin. ===Modern Age=== ====Battle at Avengers Mansion==== left|thumb|Battling Thor Arriving in the modern world, Bres infiltrated Avengers Mansion, where he encountered the incapacitated forms of Doctor Druid and Iron Man. Preparing to eliminate them, he was intercepted by Thor and She-Hulk, who had been inadvertently sent back in time by Balor, a Fomorian general. Bres initially held his own against the two heroes, attempting to exploit Thor’s vulnerability when separated from his hammer. However, She-Hulk recalled Bres’ weakness to iron and struck him with Iron Man’s armor, creating an opening for Thor to deliver a decisive blow that incapacitated him. ====Project: P.E.G.A.S.U.S.==== thumb|150px|Corrupting "Captain Hero" After his capture, Bres was imprisoned at Project: P.E.G.A.S.U.S., where a ferrous ion-infusing machine suppressed his powers. However, power failures allowed him to secretly regain his abilities. Manipulating his captors’ ignorance, he orchestrated events within the facility, killing guards and the inmate Solarr. Seeking to corrupt the young hero Captain Hero, Bres offered to help him find his deceased mother in exchange for loyalty. His schemes drew the attention of Iron Fist, the Falcon, and security chief Guardsman. Bres briefly controlled Guardsman, forcing him to attack Falcon, but Iron Fist subdued him. When Iron Fist proved incorruptible, Bres bound him and armed Captain Hero with a flaming sword, ordering him to kill. Captain Hero resisted but was overpowered, giving Iron Fist the chance to break free and defeat Bres, who was then re-imprisoned.
weaknesses: He is susceptible to magic, and iron which can disrupt his Earth-based magical powers.

bret adams.name: Bret Adams
bret adams.origin: Bret Adams had a reputation for cleaning up lawless towns with steel nerves and a fast gun. He even managed to single-handedly defeat the entire Drago Gang and run them out of town, causing the town to proclaim him a hero and make him sheriff. In actuality, Adams was a fraud. He had paid off the Drago Gang to stage a phony fight and let him run them out of town in order to gain himself a reputation. Because of his supposed acts of bravery, Laura Harrison, the daughter of the richest rancher in town, fell in love with him and they were to be married. Mister Harrison, however, suspected that Adams was a phony and only wanted to marry his daughter for their money. He told her that if she were to marry Adams that she would be cut out of her share of the inheritance. When Adams heard of this he snuck up to Harrison's ranch in the dead of night in order to bushwhack him before he could change his will. The Rawhide Kid stumbled upon Adams just as he was about to pull the trigger and grabbed him as the shot was fired. Harrison was still hit by the bullet and lapsed into a coma for several days. When the townspeople responded to the sound of the gunshot the Peacemaker blamed the Rawhide Kid, though the Kid was able to escape the ensuing posse out of town. The Kid planned on coming back for Adams, however, in order to clear his name and expose Adams for the crook that he was. The Peacemaker expected such a plan and again asked for the Drago Gang's assistance, this time to bushwhack the Rawhide Kid before he ever had a chance to make it back into town. Though the gang got the drop on the Kid in the foothills outside of town, he was still able to single-handedly fight them all and took them in to the town to be arrested. Drago admitted to the townsfolk that Adams had paid them off and that he was the one who had tried to kill Harrison. The Peacemaker and the Kid then had a draw, as Adams desperately tried to save his reputation, the Kid outdrew Adams and proceeded to embarrass him. The Kid then told Adams to get out of town rather than have him arrested, as he was now destined to travel the West forever branded as a fraud and a phony.
abilities: The Peacemaker was a decent marksman, though no where near the equal of the Rawhide Kid.
weapons: Pistols

bret colby.name: Bret Colby
bret colby.origin: Bret Colby is a gunslinger that lived in the year 1127 on Earth-6311, also known as Other-Earth, a reality where the human race did not enter a dark age in the 6th century and continued to advance technologically beyond most other alternate Earths, even after a devastating war that rolled back societal development. Colby ruled the roost of a town in an area that resembled the American Frontier of the late 19th century on Earth-616. One day he encountered the Fantastic Four, heroes from Earth-616 who were searching for Nathaniel Richards, the father of their leader Mister Fantastic. Colby and his men brought the Fantastic Four to the citadel of the Warlord, whom they believed to be the Richards patriarch at the time. The Fantastic Four soon discovered that the Warlord was really Nathaniel's wife Cassandra, whose tyranny they put to an end. Colby's subsequent activities are unknown.
weapons: Colby wields a futuristic weapon that fires heat seeking bullets and has an infrared scanner.

bret jackson.name: Bret Jackson
bret jackson.first_appearance: Spider-Man, Storm and Power Man Vol 1 1
bret jackson.origin: Bret Jackson was a student and an athletics hopeful who, however, was influenced by his girlfriend Carol to hang out in an amusement arcade where the propeitor was friendly to young people and offered them tobacco. This had an adverse effect in that his athletic performance was degrading. Powerman learns that Carol and Bret's other friends are in doing poorly in academics, as well as multiple disciplinary issues having to do with cutting school.. Bret learns that the arcade is a front for a villian known as Smokescreen, who runs a gambling racket. Smokescreen had intended for Bret's performance to falter as he was a good athlete, and his school was favored to win a track meet. Smokescreen is stopped by Storm and Spiderman and later turned over to the local police, but the medical effects of the tobacco still linger in Bret. Bret trains harder than he ever does to prepare for the track meet, but ultimately loses. He grouses that he has let his school down and is now going to have a hard time getting a college scholarship, but Power Man reminds him that he himself was a convicted felon who got a second chance at life by becoming a hero. Bret's friends realize they have no right to put him down and give him another chance.
weapons: None known
weaknesses: Peer pressure

bret labale.name: Bret Labale
bret labale.origin: thumb|left|91px|Bret Labale According to local history, the great grandfather of Bret Labale was known for his wax statue of a Satyr that local superstition had people believe was the epitome of evil. A lifetime later, Bret's father Pierre ran a successful wax museum from the family home. Business was successful for 20 years until industry in the town dried up, causing the museum to close. Pierre then became a recluse with his son Bret. By the spring of 1945, Bret had discovered that the town was sitting on a large supply of oil and began using the Satyr legend to drive people away. To this end, Bret dressed up like the Satyr statue and began murdering locals, filling them with fear. When geologist Paul Cowels came to the area under an assumed alias, he discovered the oil as well, but he too was murdered by the Satyr before he could reveal his discovery. As the Satyr murdered Cowels, the geologist's screams were heard by the passing Captain America and Bucky who then went to investigate. Chasing after the Satyr, they were unable to capture the creature, but Cap noted that his trail led to the Labale house. Soon, after hearing of the legend of the Satyr and the true identity of Paul Cowels, Cap and Bucky paid a visit to the Labale house. Bret invited them in and while Pierre told them that he thought the Satyr statue was pure evil, Bret pretended not to believe it. As the heroes went to examine the statue, Bret dressed up as a Satyr, hid the statue, and murdered his father. When Cap and Bucky doubled back upon hearing Pierre's screams, they followed his trail of blood to the real statue, with Pierre's dead body in its arms. Doffing his disguise, Bret arrived and pretended to be shocked by his father's murder, and was instructed by Cap to call the police. Instead, Bret dressed up as the Satyr and trapped Cap and Bucky with ropes suspended over a pit. However, before the Satyr could eliminate them, Cap and Bucky got free and easily subdued him. Cap unmasked the Satyr revealing him as Bret, and having deduced Bret's motivation Cap turned him over to the authorities. Bret's subsequent fate is unknown.

A lifetime later, Bret's father Pierre ran a successful wax museum from the family home. Business was successful for 20 years until industry in the town dried up, causing the museum to close. Pierre then became a recluse with his son Bret. By the spring of 1945, Bret had discovered that the town was sitting on a large supply of oil and began using the Satyr legend to drive people away. To this end, Bret dressed up like the Satyr statue and began murdering locals, filling them with fear. When geologist Paul Cowels came to the area under an assumed alias, he discovered the oil as well, but he too was murdered by the Satyr before he could reveal his discovery. As the Satyr murdered Cowels, the geologist's screams were heard by the passing Captain America and Bucky who then went to investigate. Chasing after the Satyr, they were unable to capture the creature, but Cap noted that his trail led to the Labale house. Soon, after hearing of the legend of the Satyr and the true identity of Paul Cowels, Cap and Bucky paid a visit to the Labale house. Bret invited them in and while Pierre told them that he thought the Satyr statue was pure evil, Bret pretended not to believe it. As the heroes went to examine the statue, Bret dressed up as a Satyr, hid the statue, and murdered his father. When Cap and Bucky doubled back upon hearing Pierre's screams, they followed his trail of blood to the real statue, with Pierre's dead body in its arms. Doffing his disguise, Bret arrived and pretended to be shocked by his father's murder, and was instructed by Cap to call the police. Instead, Bret dressed up as the Satyr and trapped Cap and Bucky with ropes suspended over a pit. However, before the Satyr could eliminate them, Cap and Bucky got free and easily subdued him. Cap unmasked the Satyr revealing him as Bret, and having deduced Bret's motivation Cap turned him over to the authorities. Bret's subsequent fate is unknown.

bret marlowe.name: Bret Marlowe
bret marlowe.origin: Bret Marlowe was a renowned big game hunter known for tracking dangerous animals across Africa. During one such safari, he became the first human approached by the extraterrestrial hunter Haag, who had come to Earth seeking new prey. Upon learning that Haag intended to capture humans as part of an interstellar hunt, Marlowe attempted to alert the world to the impending danger. His warning, however, came too late to prevent Haag from initiating his campaign. Realizing that conventional resistance would fail against alien technology, Marlowe searched for an alternative solution. Drawing inspiration from documentary footage of elephant hunts, he concluded that the only effective strategy was to reverse roles — turning the hunter into the hunted. Marlowe deliberately exposed himself as bait, encouraging Haag to pursue him. Once the alien committed to the chase, Marlowe coordinated with military forces, who deployed a massive net over Haag’s spacecraft, trapping the alien and forcing his surrender. The experience profoundly changed Marlowe. Having personally felt the fear and vulnerability of being the hunted, he renounced big game hunting, declaring he would never again pursue animals for sport. .

brethren uni mind.name: Brethren Uni-Mind
brethren uni mind.origin: ===Origin=== A species created from bacteria and given sentience by the Celestials, the Brethren were given group telepathic abilities, allowing them to ultimately form an Uni-Mind such as the Eternals were. ===Formation=== Facing extinction of the Brethren (stripped of their consciousness by the Collector) and of the humans (attacked by the now-mindless Brethren) Thane Ector and his Fool, on a suggestion of the Vision and aided by Eternal Sersi, were able to tap in their telepathic potential and assemble their Brethren into their very Uni-Mind. The Uni-Mind assaulted the Collector. While that effort led to the Uni-Mind's destruction, the seemingly destroyed Collector in fact teleported away to his ship. The strain of the Uni-Mind cost the lives of both last the Fool and Thane Ector, the later passing away in Sersi's arms with a last kiss. Captain America epilogued that Brethren had in the end became what Ector wanted them to be. ===Aftermath=== Sersi forming a Uni-Mind with the Brethren was considered a proof of her instability by her fellow Eternals, as cross-species Uni-Mind are supposed to be forbidden.

brett alstettler.name: Brett Alstettler
brett alstettler.origin: Brett Alstettler was an attorney and a friend of Jay Jameson, who had been his client for forty years. After Jay's death, Brett attempted to follow through with his wish that his wife May Parker was taken care of financially. However, between Jay's publisher not being forthcoming about royalties and Jay's estate having been devalued by investing in Parker Industries, May was left broke. Brett took May to dinner and went over her situation. However, May was indignant after Brett showed romantic interest in her. She spilled her drink on Brett and left. May would later return to the restaurant to treat a homeless person, who was unbeknownst to her Ned Leeds, and made Brett pay the bill. The restaurant subsequently became the scene of a confrontation between Taskmaster and Black Ant, and Rhino, and the restaurant's ceiling caved in as a result of the fight. Spider-Man managed to save the staff and customers who had become trapped under the rubble, including Brett.

To this end he recruited Luther Mannheim to obtain a poison that could be undetectable and usable on large groups, but the effect would take months or even a year to take effect. Baron Argus was confronted by the british who recruited Shang-Chi to halt his weapon's smuggling operation. In response, Argus had Leiko Wu kidnapped and brought to him to obtain information on Shang-Chi and the british. After torturing her failed, Argus cut off her hand and sent to the Shang-Chi as a warning. Shang-Chi eventually tracked down Argus and although he doused Shang-Chi with the poison, he was beaten and arrested.

brian callahan.name: Brian Callahan
brian callahan.species: Human mutated by a lunar object of unknown origin
brian callahan.origin: Brian Callahan was an NLVU professor with a career going nowhere, and he had a large reserve of jealous rage. When the spoor of a mysterious lunar object which was recovered by the astronauts of the Icarus One made its way to the general population, Callahan was one of those unfortunate enough to be compatible with it. His rage found fulfillment, and he became, in his own words, "a psychopathic Michaelangelo's David". Now calling himself Mangog, Callahan came into conflict with Wolf, Ruler of the Winds, another superhuman. Exhausted by the conflict, Callahan returned to work, but was contacted by Dr. Emil Burbank, who made the offer of trying to harness Callahan's powers. As a result of Burbank's actions, Mangog came into conflict with Nick Fury's Squadron Supreme, but was taken down by Ted Munn. His comatose form was revived by Wolf to stand against Hyperion's coup against the United States, but his powers were sapped by an unknown energy.
abilities: Physics: In his civilian life Brian is a physic professor.
weaknesses: Mangog's powers only last for as long as he remains awake. As soon as he runs out of energy, he reverts to his normal human form.
affiliations: Strategic Hazard Intervention Espionage Logistics Directorate (Earth-31916)/Members

brian dunlap.name: Brian Dunlap
brian dunlap.origin: ===Factor Three=== Brian Dunlap, also known as the Ogre, was a human inventor who has been classified as a genius as well as an agent of the organization called Factor Three. Factor Three's mission was to spy on the X-Men and kidnap Professor X. The team consisted of Unus the Untouchable, Vanisher, Blob, Mastermind, and Mutant Master. To achieve their goal, they had taken Banshee under mental control. Ogre only worked as tech support and remained at the Mount Charteris base awaiting the team's return. Ogre's first attempt to capture Xavier with Banshee's help failed. ===Thunderbolts=== After Factor Three's defeat, Mount Charteris was taken over by various groups but Ogre remained there, hiding and stealing food and supplies. Ogre remained hidden until the Masters of Evil imprisoned Moonstone. He saw this as wrong, rescuing Moonstone from her captivity by hiding a key where she could find it. When the Thunderbolts took over the base, the Ogre remained in hiding until he realized that the Thunderbolts were not as bad as those who had been there before them and decided to help them. He built weapons and technology and left them for the reformed villains to find. The team tried to find their mysterious benefactor and set up traps throughout the base, but he evaded them all. Atlas decided that this was not working so he openly thanked Ogre for his help, and with this sincere statement Ogre revealed himself to the team. Hawkeye checked on his background and when he was cleared he was welcomed to join the team. Unfortunately, Ogre was then almost immediately captured and replaced by the former Thunderbolt, Techno, who posed as Ogre for weeks to retake his place on the team. Ogre was eventually freed after Techno's death, and moved Humus Sapien's stasis pod into tesseracted space in order to hide from S.H.I.E.L.D.. Eventually, however, Humus Sapien was released, and his power was a threat to the entire planet. Ogre felt guilty for his part and decided to follow the Humus Sapien to a distant planet and live in exile with him.
abilities: Gifted inventor and technician.

fields.notes: Despite being a genius inventor, Dunlap was apparently outclassed by the Fixer. Due to prolonged isolation in Mount Charteris, Dunlap became both agoraphobic and xenophobic. Despite having an arsenal of technological weapons, Dunlap often resorts to using the light flash in his belt. It simply blinds his opponents, allowing him to escape. The Ogre served as the original partner of Banshee in his first appearance, but was entirely overlooked in subsequent stories about Factor Three. Decades later, he was revived and revamped in the original Thunderbolts series. After a failed mission against the X-Men, Dunlap was chastised by the Mutant Master. He was instructed to wait at their organization's base in Mount Charteris until the Mutant Master returned to punish him. The Mutant Master died and Factor Three disbanded, but it is unclear if anybody bothered to inform Dunlap about these events. He followed the Mutant Master's last instructions to him and kept waiting. He passed the time by running experiments on Humus Sapien and his powers. The former base Factor Three was variously taken over by the Sons of the Serpent, Hydra, and the Secret Empire. All three organizations failed to notice that Dunlap was still living in the base, and that he helped himself to their food, supplies, and technology. When S.H.I.E.L.D. captured Hydra's former base, they searched for hidden assets and then sealed it. The careless agents failed to notice Dunlap hiding within the base. When the latest incarnation of the Masters of Evil took over the base, Dunlap was still unseen. But he took an instant dislike to this group.

brian dunlop.name: Brian Dunlop
brian dunlop.origin: Part of Gene Nation, a group of Morlock whom Storm encountered and relocated to Africa, Boost was a mutant who functioned like a living battery cell. He could augment other mutants' powers by a process called "body-jumping", wherein Boost merged with other mutants and boosted their powers. When Humanity's Last Stand attacked the former Gene Nationals at their new home, Storm, the X-Men, and Havok's Brotherhood arrived to offer the mutants protection against their enemies. Humanity's Last Stand was eventually defeated, and Boost, along with fellow former Gene National Tether, sought to leave, helping the Brotherhood escape in return for being dropped off at an unrevealed place of their choosing. Boost was affected by the M-Day, and lost his mutant powers. Boost was somehow repowered, and became a citizen of Krakoa. He was suggested as a potential replacement for Cortez in S.W.O.R.D..
powers: Biomorphically merged with his own mutagenic aura, then infused himself into the bodies of others, supercharging their mutant powers.

brian fitzgerald.name: Brian Fitzgerald
brian fitzgerald.first_appearance: Black Panther: The Man Without Fear Vol 1 513
brian fitzgerald.origin: Brian was a waiter working in a dinner in Hell's Kitchen. When T'Challa decided to replace Daredevil as Hell's Kitchen in a quest for self discovery, he became the dinner's manager. When T'Challa went after new crime lord, Vladimir Dinu, the latter deduced T'Challa's base of operation and set a bank attack to draw him, taking Brian hostage in the process. During Vlad and T'Challa's confrontation, Brian was hit by one of Vlad's lightbolt and fall from the roof. Brian was badly injured and transported to the hospital where Dr. Holman declared him dead. However, Brian was still alive and was used as a test subject by Holman and Nicolae Dinu, Vlad's son, to try and replicate Vlad's powers. The experiment succeeded, however Holman proceeded brain surgery on him to render him docile. Gabe Dinu, Nicolae's younger brother, took pity on him a used a power failure to break him free. Gabe quickly realized he couldn't take care of Brian, and let him by himself. Soon after, Brain used his power to kill a rat. Gabe then revealed the truth to T'Challa, who decided to look back for Brian.

When T'Challa went after new crime lord, Vladimir Dinu, the latter deduced T'Challa's base of operation and set a bank attack to draw him, taking Brian hostage in the process. During Vlad and T'Challa's confrontation, Brian was hit by one of Vlad's lightbolt and fall from the roof. Brian was badly injured and transported to the hospital where Dr. Holman declared him dead. However, Brian was still alive and was used as a test subject by Holman and Nicolae Dinu, Vlad's son, to try and replicate Vlad's powers. The experiment succeeded, however Holman proceeded brain surgery on him to render him docile. Gabe Dinu, Nicolae's younger brother, took pity on him a used a power failure to break him free. Gabe quickly realized he couldn't take care of Brian, and let him by himself. Soon after, Brain used his power to kill a rat. Gabe then revealed the truth to T'Challa, who decided to look back for Brian.

brian hayward.origin: Brian Hayward is a former soldier recruited to be be one of Project Centipede's test subjects after he returned from Afghanistan. He, along with other Centipede-enhanced soldiers broke Edison Po out of prison, earning him the attention of Agent Phil Coulson and S.H.I.E.L.D.. Using his sister, Coulson and his team were able to track Hayward to an abandoned warehouse in Oakland, California. There, Hayward and a few other Centipede soldiers fought with S.H.I.E.L.D. agents Coulson, May, Ward, and Mike Peterson, a former Centipede subject now working for the other side. The agents were able to stop the soldiers, and Raina killed Hayward via an ocular implant (the same one that was done to Akela Amador) before he could give up any of Centipede's secrets.

brian king.name: Brian King
brian king.origin: Brian King was an executive at Phelcorp Industries under whose guideance the company's scientific research department increased, focusing on a program studying lizards. The reformed Dr. Connors worked at facility under King's supervision, and King constantly pressed him to move forward with his research or risk being fired. King's nagging in turn caused Connors' to become influenced by the suppressed personality of the Lizard. Connors snapped after discovering that his assistant, with whom he was infatuated, slept with King. Connors retreated to his office where King confronted him for his outburst. King tackled Connors to stop him from consuming a vial he believed contained the Lizard Formula, unaware that the serum was actually an antidote. Connors turned into the Lizard and partially cannibalized King.

brian kingston.name: Brian Kingston
brian kingston.origin: Brian Kingston was a childhood friend of Eric Payne, they grew up together and both enlisted in the Marines and were sent to the Vietnam War. Brian lost his leg during the war, but it didn't depress him but he got on with his life by building a nice family and living a happy life with them. When a remorseful Eric came to see him, Brian and his wife Diane welcomed him, but he became envious of the good life Brian had earned and walked away. Brian tried to stop him because he noticed something was wrong with Eric's eyes, but he couldn't because Eric teleported to the Negative Zone.

brian leighton.name: Brian Leighton
brian leighton.origin: Originally, Brian Leighton was a young boy who was patient the the psychiatrist, Dr. Meridian. His mutant abilities granted him the ability to reshape the environment as he saw fit, and even as he grew to be a man, he remained mentally a child living in a fantasy world, confined to Meridian's care. When Spider-Woman (Mattie Franklin) happened to pass by the psychiatric institute to which he had been committed. His powers fed off her own telepathic ones, and was excited to experience the life of a superhero. To that end, he created a new body with which to battle her, that of the Rhino. As the fight continued, he also added the powers of Doctor Octopus and Venom to the body. With the aid of Madame Web, Spider-Woman tracked down Meridian and interrogated him about Brian. Madame Web allowed Spider-Woman's mind to battle Brian's on the psychic plane, while giving a command to Mattie's physical body to knock out Meridian; there had been a psychic link between the two all along, with Maridian's unscrupulous mind, being fed off by Brian, proving responsible for the latter's rampage. The link broken, Madame Web telepathically switched off Brian's powers so that he would never be a threat again.

brian mckeever.name: Brian McKeever
brian mckeever.origin: Brian McKeever, better known as Tiny McKeever, was part of a group of kids in Queens, New York, consisting of Liz Allan, Charlie Murphy, Sally Avril, Seymour O'Reilly, Jason Ionello, and Peter Parker who were friends since elementary school. But by the time they arrived at Midtown High School, Peter had been drifting apart for a while and the clique was taken over by new student Flash Thompson. 180px|thumb|left|High School Years After this, Tiny would often join Flash in bullying Peter and, one day, stole his notes for no good reason. Later that day, Tiny was verbally abused by his father and even beaten up for his low school grades. Peter, who had sneaked up to his house to recover his notes, witnessed this and offered to help Tiny study. He was surprised at first, but accepted his offer. From then on, he gained a measure of respect for Peter, frequently defending when the others would bully him. One day, after his father broke his arm in a beating, Tiny finally decided he'd had enough and left home, also quitting school to work full time on a gas station and earn some money to pay rent. When Peter accidentally bumped into him, Tiny was happy to see an old face, but when Peter told him he had to finish high school, Tiny got defensive and told him to leave. As Peter's duties as Spider-Man brought him to the gas station again, however, Peter approached Tiny as Spider-Man and told him he shouldn't sell himself short. Tiny returned to school shortly afterwards. Many years later, McKeever became a security officer at the Empire State University.

brian morrison.name: Brian Morrison
brian morrison.origin: Brian Morrison was just a regular kid until his mutant abilities manifested while he was in the city of Port Washington, New York. Brian who was in a frantic state accidentally unleashed his cosmic power among the town destroying buildings, roads and literally anything in his path. His energy signature was detected by Cerebro which led to the X-Men arriving on the scene in the Blackbird. Prestige tried to calm Brian down telepathically, but he was too powerful for her to make contact with, creating an energy feedback that struck Rachel to the ground. With Brian being an Omega Level Mutant, Kitty began to reason with him by saying that he can control is abilities. He believed himself to be a monster, but Kitty reassured him that anyone would be frightened if one day they woke up with the powers of a god. She was able to help Brian power down to his human form and told him that he could come to the Xavier Institute for Mutant Education and Outreach where he would be taught on how to control his amazing gifts. But all of a sudden Brian fell down after being shot in the head by one of the townspeople who thought he was threat due to the amount of damage he had done to the city. Kitty had Nightcrawler teleport them to North Shore Medical Center where Brian was automatically seen by someone in the emergency room. After a while, the doctor came out and gave the results to Kitty but told her that he couldn't save him due to his uncontrollable powers and that he wasn't going to risk the lives of everyone in the hospital if Brain were to flare up under anesthesia. Dr. Kosineski then appeared and said that she would perform the surgery after she had a change of heart about her feelings towards mutants when she saw them save the city against an alien god. After a couple hours had past the X-Men stayed in the waiting room wondering if Brian was going to pull through. Brian survived the procedure, and eventually regained consciousness. Feeling guilty for the destruction he had caused, he tried to deny his mutant status. However, Kitty Pryde was present to help him, and told him he had either the option to go out and be one of the mutants that the world feared, or become an X-Man.
powers: Cosmic Energy Discharge: Brian's ability enabled him to generate and possibly manipulate cosmic energy. His powers were considered off the charts, Cerebro registering him to be an Omega Level mutant.

brian muldoon.name: Brian Muldoon
brian muldoon.origin: This New York City police Sergeant was often outraged at the bizarre behavior and frequent absences and disappearances of rookie policeman Steve Rogers. Muldoon routinely berated Rogers on more than one occasion. Muldoon later turned to a life of crime. Taking command of a large group of super-villains and assuming the guise of the hooded "Cowled Commander", Muldoon created a crime-wave of looting in New York City. His schemes were eventually found out and Muldoon and his allies were captured by Captain America and the Falcon. Muldoon became obeseed with destroying Captain America. He hired the Manipulator to kill the hero. During the Manipulator's ruse to cause Steve Rogers to lose his mind, Muldoon lost his patience and attempted to shoot Captain America in the back of the head. However, Captain America was only feigning a mental breakdown and quickly subdued Muldoon. Muldoon has apparently been incarcerated since this murder attempt.
