brian rinehart.name: Brian Rinehart
brian rinehart.origin: Agent Brian Rinehart of the Commission on Superhuman Activities was sent to investigate the appearance of a rogue Sentinel at a high school in Wisconsin. Rinehart tracked down the Sentinel, but he and his men were defeated by it. Rinehart was spared execution as a mutant by the arrival of Juston Seyfert. Recognizing Juston's abilities as a mechanic, leading him to suspect, correctly, that Juston was the one in control of the Sentinel. Rinehart confronted Juston again, at the hospital where his brother Chris was a patient. When Chris's conditioned worsened and he had to be transferred to a hospital in Wausau, Rinehart offered to drive Juston. On the drive, Rinehart revealed that he knew who was in control of the Sentinel, and chided Juston for acting so rashly. Just then, the Sentinel, its original programming restored, wrecked the car in pursuit of Rinehart. Rinehart revealed himself as a mutant, and in the ensuing battle, he and the Sentinel slew each other, causing Rinehart to fall into coma, and soon dying.
powers: thumb|left|Rinehart's powers. Rinehart could channel energy through his hands, forming it into different shapes, including blasts and forcefields. He was described by the Sentinel who tracked him as a Beta Level Mutant.

He was able to convince Talbot that he never wanted the Hulk taken out for the good of the world, he wanted to take Hulk down because it was the one thing his brother had never been able to do. Grey and the rest of the Gamma Corps were attacked by a haywire Hulk A.I., who wanted to kill them as part of the plan of the original Hulk to neutralize every Gamma-powered mutate from the Earth, even though the original Hulk's plan didn't include lethal force. After following the haywire A.I. to Fort Knox, Hulk saved the Gamma Corps from their deaths, but later stripped them of their powers.

During the first encounter, the Gamma Corps were able to successfully use teamwork to snap the Hulk's neck. This didn't last however, and it resulted in a more head on approach, Hulk was able to deal with and talk down most of the corps who realized it wasn't Hulk they were truly angry at. He was able to convince Talbot that he never wanted the Hulk taken out for the good of the world, he wanted to take Hulk down because it was the one thing his brother had never been able to do. Grey and the rest of the Gamma Corps were attacked by a haywire Hulk A.I., who wanted to kill them as part of the plan of the original Hulk to neutralize every Gamma-powered mutate from the Earth, even though the original Hulk's plan didn't include lethal force. After following the haywire A.I. to Fort Knox, Hulk saved the Gamma Corps from their deaths, but later stripped them of their powers.

brian van patrick.name: Brian Van Patrick
brian van patrick.origin: Brian Van Patrick was the grandson of Dr. Abraham Erskine, the scientist who created the Super-Soldier Serum that turned Steve Rogers into Captain America. Prior to this, Erskine had developed a special diet and exercise regimen that he theorized would allow a person to develop peak human physical abilities, but this was rejected by the U.S. government as the basis for the Super Soldier program as it required a lifetime of adherence to achieve maximum results. After Erskine's assassination, the American government deemed his previous research irrelevant to the program and did not classify it. Thus it was passed down through his family. Brian would use the research as the basis for a successful organic food business and when his own son Michael was born, decided to test the program on him to see if his grandfather had been right. As it happened, the theories were correct and Michael developed peak human physical physiology, becoming one of the greatest student athletes in the country and earning a scholarship to the University of Kentucky. Unfortunately, when it became publicly known that Michael was Dr. Erskine's great-grandson, his achievements came under heavy scrutiny. Mr. Van Patrick declared to Vance Astrovik that his son lost his scholarship and nearly lost every award he'd ever received after having been exposed by the press, although the testing all showed that his abilities were due to training. He watched the news about the landing of a huge stone spaceship in Times Square, Manhattan. Some time later, he was visited Yellowjacket and Baron von Blitzschlag, who brought his son back home, because he was certified as an ordinary kid with no superpowers. Brian moved with Michael to Bulls Gap, where they were contacted by the New Warriors. He didn't want his son to help them defeat K.I.A., fearing that he could have his brain wiped.

briar raleigh.name: Briar Raleigh
briar raleigh.origin: While a child, Briar Raleigh was a victim of one of the mutant terrorist Magneto's rampages in Seattle, costing her family and seriously damaging her leg. She went to months of physical therapy to walk again with a cybernetic brace. She tracked Magneto down years later. Locating him in Saranac Lake, New York, Briar told him she could supply information to him that would be more valuable than anything his local contacts could ever give him. Briar said that she believed that they were meant to work together, so she showed Magnus all the data that she had collected, a list of the S.H.I.E.L.D. agents tasked to capture him, their names, personnel files, potential blind spots, and points of weakness. But the real enemies were groups like the Marauders who were to blame for one of the worst massacres of all. Intrigued, Magneto took Briar up on her proposition, and, at her suggestion, re-programmed the Marauders' behavioral conditioning to follow his orders rather than those of Mister Sinister after he'd killed one more cell of them. Briar was later seen alongside Magneto when they attended a formal meeting with the Hellfire Club's New York branch. As the M-Pox became more dangerous towards mutants, Magneto began making numerous allies to further his plans. Striking a deal with Sebastian Shaw, allowed Briar to gain membership into their Inner Circle as the Black Bishop, while Erik became the White King. With Briar's connections, she was able to obtain a vial of gray matter from Someday Enterprises. She gave the sample to Psylocke, who was the only one able to read it, as she was a telepath. Due to Briar's evidence, the X-Men and the Hellfire Club investigated the company further, but as soon as they arrived, they were attacked by the same mutants who had asked for protection from Someday Enterprises. Briar continued assisting Magneto during his following missions. When he returned to his ruthless methodology to ensure mutantkind's survival, he established a new Brotherhood of Mutants, and Briar was one of its members.
powers: Briar has had cybernetic implants of Shi'ar technology, the full extent of which are presently unknown
however, at the very least they protect her from telepathic attacks or intrusions, as well as shield her from other forms of mental influence, such as Daken's ability to manipulate pheromones.

bride of frankenstein.name: Bride of Frankenstein
bride of frankenstein.species: Created in a laboratory in the 18th century.
bride of frankenstein.origin: The monster wanted revenge on Victor for abandoning him and the two eventually faced each other in an icy cave in the northern hills. The monster, now gifted with the power of speech and intellect, told Victor what he had experienced in the past two years, and now demanded that his "father" create a mate for him. He promised that if Victor agreed to give him a partner that he could love, then he would leave Europe with his bride, never to return. Victor was repulsed at the idea, but felt that he had no choice but to comply. He spent the next several nights roaming cemeteries, digging up bodies for any body parts he could find. The monster assisted in the project by murdering a young woman and stealing her still-beating heart. Victor sewed the body parts together and brought the hideous "she-thing" to life. Watching her shamble across the floor, Victor realized that he couldn't possibly allow two such creatures to exist. He flew at the monster, stabbing her repeatedly with his knife until she fell over dead. When the monster learned what Victor had done, he flew into a rage, his need for revenge against Victor Frankenstein intensified, and he satisfied this need by strangling Victor's close friend, Henry Clerval. He then tracked down Victor and his new bride, Elizabeth on their wedding night, and brutally murdered her as well.

fields.unusual_features: The Bride's body is composed of the stitched together remains of adult female corpses. She has massive scar tissue across the joints of her body where the individual limbs were sewn together. She has an ash-grey complexion similar to that of the recently deceased.

bridget chan.name: Bridget Chan
bridget chan.first_appearance: Marvel Disk Wars: The Avengers Season 1 28
bridget chan.origin: Professor Bridget Chan is the founder and leading authority on the Gaia Line Theory. The Gaia Line theory is a hypothesis that Earth is in fact 1 big organism, with the Gaia Lines running through it like blood vessels. These Gaia Lines are lines of energy that keep the Earth alive. The theory finds its origin in Ancient China’s feng shui. A month prior to her first appearance, professor Chan was abducted from her home by Crossbones and a squadron of Hydra soldiers. They forced her to perform research on how the Gaia Lines could be used to corrupt and eventually destroy the Earth. When S.H.I.E.L.D. learned about her abduction, they send Hawkeye and Falcon for a rescue mission. A mole inside S.H.I.E.L.D. tipped Hydra off about their plan, but the two managed to free professor Chan anyway. Though Hawkeye was seemingly killed in the mission, he showed up again alive and well later on. After being freed, Professor Chan was asked to tell the Avengers about her ordeal, since Red Skull intended to use her research for his master plan; to corrupt the Gaia Lines with the Dimension Sphere in order to destroy the Earth.

bridget malone.name: Bridget Malone
bridget malone.species: Empowered by the Kestrel Key of Krakkan.
bridget malone.origin: Bridget Malone was a young woman who grew up in Belfast, Northern Ireland in the midst of the troubles. Many of her male relatives were imprisoned or killed for their part in paramilitary activity, and Bridget herself was suspected of involvement with the IRA. Bridget went on the run when she was suspected of involvement in a shootout with police. While on the run, Bridget came across the mystical artifact the Kestrel Key of Krakkan, and when she touched it she was transformed into Conquest, the living embodiment of battle, one of the Exemplars. Conquest soon fought against Thor when she abducted Juggernaut when he was mid-battle with the thunder god, and with the hero Spider-Man in the Daily Bugle building when the Exemplars started working on their God Machine, a device for controlling minds. When the Exemplars moved their God Machine to the North Pole so they could take control of Earth's population, they were opposed by the Avengers, Spider-Man, and Nova. The Exemplars overcame the heroes, with Conquest personally taking out Nova and Quicksilver. However, the last Avenger standing, Captain America, however, talked one of the Exemplars, Bedlam, into turning against her teammates. The Exemplars subsequently disappeared.
powers: As the "living embodiment of battle", Conquest possesses , speed, agility, stamina, reflexes, and durability. She is also skilled in the use of a myriad of weapons.
abilities: As Conquest, Bridget's fighting ability was greatly enhanced.

bridgit shane.name: Bridgit Shane
bridgit shane.origin: Born in Edinburgh, Scotland, Bridgit lived a normal life until shortly after moving to Kinross, when her mutant powers first manifested. She kept them secret until, one day, while using them to light candles at her church, she was discovered by Reverend Craig. Saying she was possessed by the Devil, Craig made her feel ashamed of being a mutant, much like he'd done to Wolfsbane years before. Needing a release, Bridgit left Kinross and visited a nearby forest, where she unleashed her powers to their full extent. This display of her power was spotted by Wolfsbane on Muir Island. Alongside Shadowcat and Meggan, the three members of Excalibur went to investigate, finding Bridgit at the center of the firestorm and learning her origins.

brie daniels.name: Brie Daniels
brie daniels.origin: Aspiring actress Brie Daniels gatecrashed in a party given by Anthony Stark, hoping to make some professional contacts. When she was caught by Stark's security chief Garrison Quint, she claimed that Stark had personally invited her. Stark, at seeing Daniels and finding her cute, quickly agreed to follow her charade for her own good and, after hearing her story, introduced her to director Steven Spielberg, another party guest. Brie was later invited by Tony Stark to be his date at the world premiere of the controversial new film Dark Angel, but they left the cinema after Tony felt sick, empathizing with the dramatic images. Some time later, on the set of the Secret Hospital soap opera, Brie told her co-star Mary Jane Watson Parker that director Hal McGee's wife had an alcohol problem.

The other man knew enough of Strange and magic to be shocked at this news, but Brigand showed him Adolf Hitler's personal weapon, loaded with silver bullets; enough bad karma to get through Strange's magical defenses. Brigand's employer shrugged this off and took possession of the bottle, commented that he was going to study it.
abilities: Skilled thief
weapons: Hitler's Handgun (formerly)

briggs stalkers.name: Briggs (Stalkers)
briggs stalkers.origin: Venom was hit with a heat and sound bombardment from a weapon wielded by Briggs. While Venom beat into submission, Kass pummelled the symbiote with his fantastic strength. With Venom beat into submission, Trent ordered Kass to stand down, saying that the only sought to eliminate Sean. That was when Michael Badilino decided to step in, transforming into Vengeance. He staggered the Stalkers with a blast of hellfire, but Briggs stunned him with another bomb. Briggs and Trent were hunting for Vengeance. Briggs tracked his spoor and then locked onto his heat signature. They blasted the tree that Vengeance was hiding behind. However, on the other side was Michael Badilino - Vengeance's alter-ego - not recognizing him in his human form, the two members of the Stalkers departed to look for their hunt elsewhere. While their backs were turned, Badilino transformed himself into Vengeance. In South America, Trent, Raiden, and Briggs found the decapitated body of Kass. The trio absorbed Kass's life force, increasing their own power. As Trent and Raiden flew off to search for their prey, they left Briggs alone to be ambushed by Vengeance. Vengeance managed to blow Briggs into pieces with a concentrated blast of hellfire. Venom had caught up to his ally by that point and was impressed by this.

brigham fontaine.name: Brigham Fontaine
brigham fontaine.first_appearance: Spider-Man/Doctor Octopus: Out of Reach Vol 1 1
brigham fontaine.origin: Brigham was a student at Midtown High where he was tutored by Peter Parker. Sometime in the years after that, he developed a liquid electromagnet design for a bank vault which proved to be very effective when Doctor Octopus attempted to rob the bank, destroying the building with the vault remaining intact and undamaged. When it was released in the news that Brigham was the vault's creator, Doc Ock kidnapped him in an attempt to make him create a way to break the vault, finding Brigham willing and enthusiastic to help. Brigham began to act as Ock's protegee, resenting how reliant he was on other people and seeing Ock's independence as everything he wanted to emulate. Continuing to work with Ock both on the vault and various side projects, Brigham eventually created a belt device which could harness the natural electricity of a person's own body to disrupt the electromagnetic field of a target. When Spider-Man arrived to attempt to "rescue" Brigham, believing him to be there against his will, Brigham used the device in his attempt to escape the resulting fight, successfully breaking through a wall before passing out. He was returned home by Spider-Man, but later that night went out on his own to return to working with Ock of his own volition. Eventually, they both found an effective way to break into the vault Brigham had designed, with Ock using the belt device to tear the vault open and steal the money together. After the robbery, Brigham was surprised to hear Ock intended to hoard the money as an expression of power instead of spending it, saying that he would want to use it to help Ock to be freed of the unwieldy nature of his mechanical arms and become more powerful without them. Originally appalled at the suggestion, Ock was eventually convinced to undergo the process Brigham proposed, to make him more physically powerful and emit energy from his body to better power and control his arms. In the beginning of the process, Ock was reminded of the accident that led to the arms being welded to his body and broke out of the chamber, refusing to continue the process and attempting to attack Brigham just as Spider-Man arrived to take Brigham away, believing him to have been kidnapped again. In the confusion, Brigham managed to use the device to incapacitate Spider-Man and escape with Ock. Upon seeing news coverage of the event where the story presented still claimed that he was an unwilling accomplice, Brigham snuck out on his own to the local TV station, announcing to the world that not only was he doing this willingly, but he was actually the mastermind behind it all and that Ock was the one working for him. Upset at the public undermining of his authority, Ock travelled to the TV station and once again attacked Brigham, stopping when Brigham apologized and claiming that he intended to carry on Ock's name and legacy as his apprentice. Spider-Man arrived during this confrontation, splitting them up and once again attempting to rescue him. Brigham once again used the distraction of the fight to grab the device, blowing up the TV station. Ock and Spider-Man both arrived to speak to him as the device began to overload, with Spider-Man attempting to get him to take off the device and leave, and Ock telling him to destroy Spider-Man and take control of the device. Brigham, upset at this situation, set off the device again, setting off a larger explosion and escaping on his own. He sought out various power sources to maintain the still overloading device, altering his body in the process to produce more and more organic energy and steadily becoming more powerful. Spider-Man and Ock once again both tracked him down, and once again tried to convince him to go with one of them. Brigham feigned a desire to go with Spider-Man, instead knocking him out and going with Ock, telling him that he saw him as a father figure, needing his guidance to get powerful enough to control the device. Having already obtained an electrical mode of power via the city's power grid, the pair travelled to a chemical plant to facilitate the next step of Brigham's evolution. Although Spider-Man arrived and attempted to thwart this, Brigham and Ock were successful, escaping to a nuclear power plant for the final step of the evolution: to mutate Brigham's molecules and make him a walking nuclear battery. Spider-Man arrived yet again in the middle of this conversion process, battling Ock and convincing him to stop the process just as Brigham was overloaded with energy and his heart stopped. Ock performed CPR on him, saving his life, and was arrested afterwards. Later, Brigham was seen with no memory of how the ordeal ended, saying Spider-Man was the real hero who saved him and he was just confused.
abilities: Genius level intellect

bright eagle.name: Bright Eagle
bright eagle.origin: Bright Eagle was considered the greatest warrior of the Shawmis Tribe. His tribe arranged a marriage for him, his betrothed being Pale Mist of the Utabi Tribe. Crooked Knife convinced the Shawmis Tribe that Pale Mist had been abducted by the Black Rider. Bright Eagle led an expedition to rescue his bride. At a later point, the Black Rider explained to the Shawmis that Crooked Knife was manipulating them. Bright Eagle feigned sickness, and set a trap for Crooked Knife. After witnessing Crooked Knife trying to assassinate a fake Bright Eagle, the real Bright Eagle killed his foe. Bright Eagle married Pale Mist, securing a lasting peace between the Shawmis and the Utabi.

brigid thorsdottir.name: Brigid Thorsdottir
brigid thorsdottir.origin: Brigid was the daughter of Thor, who perished during the cataclysm that scorched the Earth and covered it in lethal radiation. The few survivors relocated to an underground faclity located under New York City where their numbers slowly dwindled until 2051 A.D., when Captain Marvel defeated the creature that attacked them and restarted the sun at the cost of her own life. thumb|left Proving unable to lift her father's hammer, Mjolnir, Brigid relegated herself to working as a blacksmith for the survivors. When Captain Marvel's younger self arrived at 2052 A.D. due to the machincations of Ove and the Enchantress, she was invited to Ove's haven, New Atlantis. Carol recruited Brigid as part of the group that accompanied her to Ove's territory. In New Atlantis, the heroes were captured since Ove intended to sacrifice Captain Marvel for a time-travelling spell to go to the past himself. While battling the forces of Ove and the Enchantress, Brigid called for Mjolnir when she was being swarmed by monsters. Mjolnir responded and came to Brigid, granting her the powers of Thor. In the aftermath of the Enchantress' sacrifice to send Ove herself to the past, the survivors from Emma's group moved to New Atlantis and Captain Marvel was returned to her time.

brigitte lahti.name: Brigitte Lahti
brigitte lahti.origin: Brigitte Lahti was a beggar when she was a child. After growing up she became professional assassin. Since she was from the Netherlands and had the power to create mental "snow" that blanked out others' physical senses, she was given nickname Snow Queen. Logan had learned about her when he worked for the Canadian Government. Years later, Logan encountered Snow Queen on the Madripoor. She was hired to kill a person. She had prepared explosives with a timer and put it into briefcase, however, the briefcase was stolen by a street thief. Snow Queen spent the entire day tracking him down, and fought Logan on two occasions. She managed to get the briefcase back, but, unknowingly to her, the thief managed to open it and activate the timer, so shortly after she escaped with the briefcase, it exploded and she died.
powers: Snow Queen was a mutant with several powers: : She was able to create a kind of mental static in her targets that blanked out their physical senses

the target was unable to see, hear, or feel anything, including pain, for a short time. : According to Logan, she was superhumanly strong and could kill a normal person with a kick. : She was also superhumanly fast.
weapons: Lahti used conventional firearms and knives.

brillalae.name: Brillalae
brillalae.first_appearance: Deadly Hands of Kung Fu Vol 1 20
brillalae.origin: Brillalae was hired to find someone who was worthy of becoming the Black Tiger. She encountered Abe Brown at the airport and exchanged her suitcase containing the Black Tiger costume with his. Afterwards, she returned to the Bedouin tribe who had hired her. When Brown was picked up by the tribe after his plane had crashed in the desert, she explained to him that he had to duel the Mole for the honor of becoming the Black Tiger. After Brown won the duel, she collected her pay from the Bedouins, but remained with the Bedouins to join their rebellion.

briquette.name: Briquette
briquette.origin: Briquette joined the group of female mercenaries known as the Hell's Belles and trained with their mentor Cyber. When her former teammate Shrew left the group and agreed to testify against them in court, Briquette and the Belles were dispatched to retrieve her. Briquette and Tremolo ambushed X-Factor in the hotel they were using to guard Shrew. Briquette traded blows with Strong Guy, but quickly melted the floor which caused the pair to fall to the basement. Cyber joined in the fight, pricking Strong Guy with a poisoned talon. Strong Guy then warned Briquette that she was heating up the hotel's boiler. Briquette continued to heat it with her hands until it started to explode, allowing Cyber and Briquette to escape. That night, the Hell's Belles met with X-Factor to discuss trading Shrew for Strong Guy's antidote. However, Strong Guy revealed a toxicologist had already cured the poison from his system, and a battle ensued. Briquette and Vague were swarmed by Multiple Man's dupes wearing insulated suits. Tremolo defeated the duplicates, and Briquette turned her attention to Quicksilver. She grabbed the speedster and began to melt his body until Strong Guy knocked her away. After Cyber's defeat, Briquette and her teammates were presumably taken into custody. Several years later, Briquette joined Nightcrawler's support group, Mindfulness for Mutant Appearances . Briquette joined the group for a safe space to express herself without non-mutants judging her looks. During the first meeting, Briquette became angry at Stacy X's inclusion, as she looked like an average human. After Stacy X revealed her depression at losing her powers and appearance after Decimation, Briquette reconciled and embraced her. ===Age of X-Man=== In the Age of X-Men pocket dimension Briquette was an actress with Mastermind Studios. Alongside other fellow performers from Mastermind Studios, Briquette confronted Nightcrawler. In the ensuing battle, Briquette assisted Hellion, though the fight was cut short. Later, Briquette was among several mind-controlled by the Stepford Cuckoos. She seemingly perished along with the rest of the planet when Magneto used the Life Seed to allow some of the mutants to leave the Age of X-Man. ===Krakoa=== Briquette was among the several mutants to join the X-Men on the mutant nation of Krakoa. After her depowered teammates were defeated and imprisoned by the Children of the Atom, Briquette was contacted by Vague. She traveled to the prison and freed her teammates. The Children of the Atom learned of this and attempted to stop Briquette. However, Briquette quickly defeated the young heroes until Storm appeared and invited the depowered Belles to join them on Krakoa.

briscoe borelli.name: Briscoe Borelli
briscoe borelli.origin: As a young boy, "Brains" Borelli was constantly picked on for his lack of intelligence. He would consequently grow to have a deep rooted hostility for those of exceptional intelligence, specifically scientists. As an adult, he amassed enough criminal power to become a leading crime boss in the city, gloating over how he had everyone in his pocket. He took personal joy in loaning money to scientists whom could not pay him back so that he could send his men to destroy their inventions. One such scientist was Enoch Mason, inventor of the "Dimensional Smasher". On the night that he activated the device, Borelli sent his men to collect or destroy the device. However, the smoke from one of his minion's cigars unleashed Aarkus the Vision. The Vision slew Borelli's men, saving Mason. Later, Borelli sent men to kidnap Mason, his daughter Sheila, and Aarkus (now in a human form). Aarkus revived first and was told by Borelli that they were to be killed. Asking for a "last cigarette", Aarkus transformed into his Vision form and easily beat Borelli and his gang, leaving them for the authorities to apprehend.

fields.history: As a young boy, "Brains" Borelli was constantly picked on for his lack of intelligence. He would consequently grow to have a deep rooted hostility for those of exceptional intelligence, specifically scientists. As an adult, he amassed enough criminal power to become a leading crime boss in the city, gloating over how he had everyone in his pocket. He took personal joy in loaning money to scientists whom could not pay him back so that he could send his men to destroy their inventions. One such scientist was Enoch Mason, inventor of the "Dimensional Smasher". On the night that he activated the device, Borelli sent his men to collect or destroy the device. However, the smoke from one of his minion's cigars unleashed Aarkus the Vision. The Vision slew Borelli's men, saving Mason. Later, Borelli sent men to kidnap Mason, his daughter Sheila, and Aarkus (now in a human form). Aarkus revived first and was told by Borelli that they were to be killed. Asking for a "last cigarette", Aarkus transformed into his Vision form and easily beat Borelli and his gang, leaving them for the authorities to apprehend.

briseis.name: Briseïs
briseis.origin: Briseïs was the wife of Mynes, king of Lyrnessus, a city neighboring Troy. At the beginning of the Trojan War, Achilles and his Myrmidons ravaged the cities around Troy, including Lyrnessus. Achilles killed himself Mynes and captured many men and women for slaves. Along with Chryseïs, daughter of Chryses, the priest of Apollo in the city of Chryse, Briseïs was among the most beautiful women enslaved by the Achaeans. When the lots were cast for the prisoners, Achilles received Briseïs while Chryseïs went to Agamemnon, which sparked resentment from Achilles (who made most of the fighting) towards Agamemnon (who collected the best share). Achilles asked Patroclus to return her to his camp, where she was treated well. In the ninth year of the war, as Apollo's arrows were raining on the Achaeans, caused by Chryses, Agamemnon surrendered Chryseïs, and took Briseïs in replacement, causing a quarrel decreed by Zeus between them. Later, when Achilles died, Briseïs wept more than any, except for Achilles' mother Thetis.

brittany chien.name: Brittany Chien
brittany chien.origin: Brittany Chien was a martial artist who became an operative of the Techuza at some point of her life, using the codename Shuriken. She had a tumultuous relationship with a man named Jerald Dragoon, producing a son named Hayes. When her son contracted the deadly Theta Virus, however, Shuriken accepted an offer from the American intelligence agency called Aladdin to research a cure for her son. Shuriken found herself as a top agent to Aladdin, answering only to its secret boss, the A.I. GENIE. She was still a blackmailed servant, because GENIE was dangling her son's fate before her constantly in order to ensure her compliance. The computer ordered her to retrieve powerful ultras for Aladdin, such as Gemini and Rune. She watched the battle between the two powerful ultras and when she finally met Gemini, she decided to not capture him. Later she was trapped by Aladdin operatives inside a special contention chamber and transported ia a spaceship to the Outer Solar System, where she participated in the acquisition of the cocoon of Adam Warlock that came from Earth-616. After the Black September reality changes, her involvement with the cocoon was seemly erased, and she was given a last task by GENIE: To capture the most powerful ultra of all: Amber Hunt.

fields.notes: "Shuriken" was an independent creator-owned series created by Reggie Byers and published by Victory Productions from 1985 to 1987. After the end of the first , the character moved to Eternity Comics, an imprint of Malibu Comics, with the series . Reggie Byers sold the rights to Malibu in late 1987, making Shuriken one of the first characters that were owned directly by the publisher rather than the creators. After several limited series (Shuriken Cold Steel, Hellbender and Shuriken (1991), the character was rebooted as part of the Ultraverse in 1995.Shuriken apparead for her first time in the Ultraverse in , and had a full appearance in . Despite a change in name, the rebooted character (Brittany Chien) had a similar appearance, powers, and backstory to the original incarnation (the ninja Kyoko Shidara), and could be in fact the same character, only a bit older and using an alias. "Shuriken" has been owned by Marvel since 1994, so that's the reason why Marvel Database covers her pre-Malibu appearances (for similar cases, see ).

brix.name: Brix
brix.origin: One of the family members of the Inheritors, he and his twin sister Bora seem to have a competition to see who can kill the most Spider-Totems. One day during their hunt, they came to a world inhabited by Cyborg Spider-Man. Superior Spider-Man and his team of Spider-Man counterparts were rescuing Cyborg Spider-Man from Karn, the outcast from the Inheritors. This led to the siblings fighting among themselves. During a feast, Brix was feeling impatient that Morlun was taking a long time to come home. When he came back, they were asked by Solus what they think when they see the Master Weaver. He and Bora suggested it is like a sport, and they shall play and play until the end of time. After Daemos was killed by Spider-Man, Brix, Bora and a clone of Daemos battled the Spider-Army. After Silk, Spider-Woman and Spider-Man Noir tried to draw the Inheritors away from the Spider-Army, Brix and Bora went after them. When the Inheritors managed to gather three spider-totems needed to perform a ritual, The Other, The Scion, and The Bride, the Spider-Army formed to oppose the Inheritors travelled to their base, Loomworld, to stop them. In the end, the Spider-Army managed to overpower the Inheritors and stop the ritual which would've ended them all. The Inheritors were left in Earth-3145, a universe with a radioactive Earth, where they would die due to them being extremely vulnerable to radiation, and couldn't escape, because the Master Weaver they had enslaved and used to travel across the Multiverse had been killed. However, Spider-Man gave them the knowledge of a shelter in Sims Tower, where they could survive, but not pose a threat anymore. The Inheritors eventually escaped their prison after Jennix managed to hack Otto Octavius's databases, using Otto's spare clone bodies as a means of transferring their souls into Earth-616, engaging the Spider-Army once more. After the defeat of their father, the Spider-Army managed to turn all other Inheritors except Morlun in to babies and remove their hunger for Totems. They were sent to live with Spider-Ma'am on Earth-3123. After the totemic wasp-goddess Shathra had been freed once more, she eventually corrupted Spider-Ma'am and killed all baby Inheritors, Brix included.
weapons: Whip: Brix carried a whip on his person whenever he uses it into combat.
weaknesses: Radiation: Brix and the Inheritors are extremely sensitive to radiation.

brock jones.name: Brock Jones
brock jones.origin: Brock Jones, a former professional football player, donned the Torpedo Armor at the request of a dying Michael Stivak, the former Torpedo, and eventually used its technology for good. He clashed with Daredevil who was pursuing the original Torpedo and in the aftermath of their battle, decided to retire from super-heroics. His life as an insurance salesman didn't satisfy him, however, and he picked up the mantle once more, teaming up with Daredevil to take down the Chameleon. Jones was one of a group of adventurers who temporarily joined the Defenders for a single day, but left the team along with most of the other new recruits at the end of that day. Jones later moved to Clairton, West Virginia. There, he met ROM: Spaceknight and they battled the Rocketeers, who were Dire Wraiths in disguise. After learning of the Earth's infestation by the Dire Wraiths, Brock Jones becomes friends with ROM and protected Clairton in the Spaceknight's absence. Jones was later killed in battle with the Dire Wraiths.

brok asgardian.origin: Thor and the Warriors Three happened upon a bar brawl involving Tyr, Brok, Galp and Drom the Spirit-Weaver, four ne'er-do-wells. They broke up the fight and the two groups then ended up challenging each other to see who was superior. Tyr chose Fandral, Galp faced Hogun, Brok faced Thor, and Drom faced Volstagg. The tournament got underway starting with a battle royal to see who was the bravest warrior of them all. Participating in the event were Thor, the Warriors Three, Tyr, Brok, Galp and Drom. As planned these eight warriors paired off fighting their supposed equal opponent to see which one was the better of the other. As this contest went on, the Destroyer armor arrived on the Bifrost Bridge, and Heimdall proved to be little match to stop it from crossing into Asgard.

brona asgardian.origin: Brona the Enchanter was one of the Enchanters, Asgard-based sorcerers who sought power through their Living Talisman. One of the middle brothers, he wielded a mace in battle. It was Brona who discovered the invisible barrier causing the travel from the Inner Realms to realms beyond nearly impossible (though a few adept wizards could pass through it). The separation was named Brona's Barrier, after its discoverer. The Architect of the Bifrost would later create the Prismatic Bridge of Asbru as a way across the barrier. After being defeated by Thor he was exiled to the Lost Limbo of Infinity Unending alongside Magnir. Eventually freed by Enrakt he and Magnir ambushed Odin, transporting him extradimensionally to battle. He was defeated by Odin after Thor and the Scarlet Witch joined the fight, and Odin shattered both his mask and his Living Talisman. When threatened with death he told the story of how Enrakt came to be associated with Ceranda before being banished back to the Lost Limbo of Infinity Unending alongside Magnir.
weapons: Living Talismans

bronaja.name: Bronaja
bronaja.origin: Bronaja was an Inhuman from Attilan. He and his sister Iridia were exposed to the Terrigen Mist at the same Terrigenesis Ceremony. Although the Terrigen gave Iridia large wings that labeled her as a "flier" in Attilan's rigid caste system, Bronaja emerged from his Terrigenesis chamber apparently unchanged. When Attilan's prince Maximus - himself unaffected by the mists - put his hand on Bronaja's back to comfort him, Bronaja was given a seizure-inducing vision of snakes pinning Maximus against a wall. Although the Genetic Council deemed his abilities useless to their society, Maximus grew to believe in Bronaja's visions, and used him as a guide during his coup to overthrow King Black Bolt. After the coup, Maximus found Bronaja and his father in the city's mine tunnels, and promised them that Bronaja and all of Attilan's lower caste citizens would have a place in his bold vision for the Inhumans' future.
powers: Bronaja is given seizure inducing visions when entering contact with other beings.

Although the Terrigen gave Iridia large wings that labeled her as a "flier" in Attilan's rigid caste system, Bronaja emerged from his Terrigenesis chamber apparently unchanged. When Attilan's prince Maximus - himself unaffected by the mists - put his hand on Bronaja's back to comfort him, Bronaja was given a seizure-inducing vision of snakes pinning Maximus against a wall. Although the Genetic Council deemed his abilities useless to their society, Maximus grew to believe in Bronaja's visions, and used him as a guide during his coup to overthrow King Black Bolt. After the coup, Maximus found Bronaja and his father in the city's mine tunnels, and promised them that Bronaja and all of Attilan's lower caste citizens would have a place in his bold vision for the Inhumans' future.

During the game, he stood with the fans. With each cheer and roar, the BrooklyKnight's power grew stronger and spread. After the Nets won the game, the rumbles faded, and the arena slowly emptied until only he stood alone at center court, finishing his job of defending his court.
fields.notes: thumb|right One of the last panels of the comic showed five players standing behind the knight. From left to right, these players were (#45), (#7), (number hidden but shown as #11 earlier in the comic), (#9), and (#8). Given how none of them play for the Nets as of June 22, 2017, all five players should be considered topical references per the Sliding Timescale of Earth-616.
fields.trivia: According to Bill Rosemann, an editor for Marvel Custom Solutions at the time the character was introduced, "When Nets fans meet their guardian, they will immediately know that the House of Ideas has once again unleashed a hero who will soon be known all over the world for his nobility, grit, and strength. Brooklyn, your champion is here!" thumb|right|Trading card The BrooklyKnight was created as part of a collaboration between Marvel Entertainment and the . "As a Brooklynite and a hardcore hoops fan, for me to get the opportunity to help create a Super Hero for my home borough's new team was a dream come true," said Axel Alonso, Editor-in-Chief, at the time, for Marvel Entertainment. "Working with the Nets staff, we have created a team Super Hero that is unlike anything the NBA has ever seen; a timeless character who can stand shoulder to shoulder with icons like Spider-Man, Captain America, Wolverine, and Thor. Let's go, Nets!" BrooklyKnight made his debut in the Brooklyn Nets' first-ever regular season game in their new home, , against the . Before the start of the game, the BrooklyKnight boldly landed at center court to inspire his team and rally the crowd. To commemorate the first appearance of this historic new sports icon, Marvel Custom Solutions worked with the Nets to create , a limited-edition comic which all guests at the game received copes of. Additionally, all guests at the Brooklyn Nets vs. game at Barclays Center on Sunday, November 11, 2012, received a limited-edition BrooklyKnight trading card, courtesy of Marvel Custom Solutions and the Brooklyn Nets. The BrooklyKnight was developed to replace Sly Fox, the team's mascot for its final 15 seasons in New Jersey. On March 21, 2014, on writer 's podcast, he said he had heard (but not quite confirmed) that the Nets had considered a redesign for their mascot and had reached out to television host for his input (along with Marvel Comics) on a new look. A Nets insider dismissed the rumor at the time. "Someone is spreading nasty rumors," said the insider. "He is here to stay!!!" Lowe later reported via Twitter on July 9th, 2014, that the Nets had informed their mascot that he would not be returning next season (possibly placing the character on hiatus... or worse). In a follow-up tweet, he clarified that the decision stemmed from dissatisfaction with the knight character itself, not the person playing the mascot. A day later, it was confirmed by the that the team had decided to part ways with the character after two years. As of July 10, 2014, at 3:53 p.m. EDT, the Nets have no plans to have a new mascot in the near future. Part of the Nets' decision to ditch the mascot was the name, which was a little too close to that of a male adult film star for the team's liking. The team had also received complaints of the mascot frightening young kids. A team official said that the Nets "had to face reality that he didn't work out."

brooklyn barnes.name: Brooklyn Barnes
brooklyn barnes.species: and Bucky were combined in a Marvel versus DC crossover
brooklyn barnes.origin: In the early days of World War II, schoolboy "Brooklyn" Barnes joined up with the Young Commandos and became the official kid mascot of the All-Star Winners Squadron. In February 1942, young "Brooklyn" Barnes was present in the All-Star Winners Squadron's Midtown Clubhouse in Metropolis when Super-Soldier (Clark Kent) returned from a top-secret mission briefing in Washington, D.C. Super-Soldier informed his fellow Winners that he had been ordered to follow a consignment of stolen government equipment being smuggled overseas. "Brooklyn" Barnes offered to come along with the Young Commandos (although American Belle thought that this was merely an excuse for Barnes to skip school), but Super-Soldier turned down the young boy's offer because it was an undercover mission. Decades later, "Brooklyn" Barnes (now an adult) became a member of the New York Special Crimes Unit, a division of the New York City Police Department that specializes in dealing with metahuman criminals. Along with the rest of the New York Special Crimes Unit, "Brooklyn" Barnes opened fire on the villain King Lizard as he battled Spider-Boy (Pete Ross) on Kesel Street in New York City. Although they temporarily stunned the massive villain, King Lizard retaliated by ripping the pipes out from under the street, causing the entire New York Special Crimes Unit to come crashing to the ground. Afterwards, "Brooklyn" Barnes and the Special Crimes Unit were forced to regroup and leave King Lizard for Spider-Boy to handle on his own.

broseph simpkins the seventh.name: Broseph Simpkins the Seventh
broseph simpkins the seventh.origin: Broseph Simpkins the Seventh, better known as Snapper, was a life-form created by M.O.D.O.K. to be his assistant. Before joining S.H.I.E.L.D., M.O.D.O.K. and Snapper launched an operation to betray Maria Hill and destroy the organization as soon as they became part of it, under the belief that bullies had to be dealt with, and S.H.I.E.L.D. was "all about [bullies]." M.O.D.O.K. and Snapper sent the android known as The Fury to the mysterious Tlön to see what would come back, and later placed it on the Misericordia, a S.H.I.E.L.D. satellite, to kill agents Fury and Coulson. He later hired a Latverian assassin who tried and failed to kill Maria Hill to instill in her the idea that someone was coming for her. However, M.O.D.O.K. found himself having fallen in love with Maria Hill, and backed down from his plan. As soon as Maria Hill's suspicions were confirmed, she tried to confront M.O.D.O.K., but he had disappeared from the Helicarrier. Meanwhile, Snapper had carried on with M.O.D.O.K.'s plan and kidnapped Maria Hill. In the Venezuelan Rainforest, Snapper planned to unleash the monsters from Tlön on the Earth. He set up a chain of people to be used as mediums for Tlön's rise, forming a communal mindscape that used emotional negativity to create a gate for this purpose. Maria Hill was placed in the center of it. When M.O.D.O.K. and the Secret Avengers arrived to stop him, Snapper tagged him with a transmission conductor, turning him into another medium. During the emergence of the monstrosities from Tlön, Spider-Woman used her pheromones to emotionally subdue Snapper. The rest of the Secret Avengers tagged themselves with transmission conductors to infiltrate the mindscape and imagine the best possible universe and try to outweigh the negativity of Tlön. When everything was coming apart at the seams, the final part of M.O.D.O.K.'s plan to defeat Snapper was put in motion, and the sentient bomb Vladimir was dropped on the portal to Tlön. Vladimir opened a black hole which in contact with the Tlön gate created a singularity, reverting everything back to normal. Snapper was subsequently put in a rehabilitation program with a shaman in Peru.

brother brood.name: Brother Brood
brother brood.species: Metamutant infected by a Brood Queen ( and a Queen Brood were combined in a Marvel versus DC crossover)
brother brood.origin: In an unspecified Brood foray to Earth, the enigmatic cult leader known as Brother Brood was infected with the egg of a Brood Queen, and experienced a "spiritual" awakening, coming to believe that becoming one with the Brood was the only truth. He infected his followers, and, in turn, they kidnapped the metamutant Terra-X for him, but their actions did not go unnoticed, as Shatterstarfire of the X-Patrol witnessed the attack, and along with Niles Cable, travelled deep into his lair beneath Zenosha to rescue her. As Koriand'ru and Niles battled the Cult of Brood in an attempt to rescue Terra-X, they were quickly overwhelmed, and Niles chose to sacrifice himself by telekinetically forcing Shatterstar fire to safety. The captured Niles Cable was then brought before Brother Brood himself, who boasted that with Niles in his grasp, Zenosha and all of Earth would fall before the Cult of Brood. Implanted with a Brood egg and chained within the tunnels that housed the cult, Niles Cable was confronted by a vision of his dead wife from the far-future, Raveniya the Healer, who offered him a way to escape the infection, a way that would mean certain death. Meanwhile, Brother Brood was officiating over the "Holy Rebirth" of Terra-X into the Cult of Brood, when X-Patrol arrived and battled their way through his followers to the Brood Pit, where the ceremony was taking place. As the heroes confronted Brother Brood, Terra-X, now calling herself Terra-X the Destroyer, emerged from the Brood Pit, fully under Brood control, and viciously attacked them, only to be knocked unconscious by Elasti-Girl, who had shrunken and entered her inner ear. Dial H.U.S.K., in the form of Artemisty Knight, the bionic Amazon Archer, took aim at the cult leader on his perch above the Brood Pit, but was surprised when her arrow struck only an empty cloak, he had draped it across a rock as a distraction, sneaking around to attack the heroes from behind. He boasted that one of their "unbelieving number" had already been "converted", and everyone assumed he was speaking of Niles. Janet attempted to attack Brother Brood, only to be blasted away by an infected Niles Cable. As the team faced defeat, Jericho spoke of a future in which Niles Cable would lead the brood to a brief, and ultimately doomed, victory, cementing humanities hatred for, and persecution of, metamutantkind. Brother Brood then transformed into his Brood Queen form, saying that "when Brood and Metamutant join, both are made more powerful!". In the chaos of battle, Jericho was revealed to be Niles Dayspring, a younger version of Niles Cable himself, and the elder Niles chose to sacrifice himself, freeing the "Soul-Self" of Raveniya he carried within him. Raveniya then enveloped Brother Brood, apparently killing him. Niles' "Techno-Virus" killed the nascent Brood within him, and would have killed him as well, had his younger self not telekinetically forced it into remission. As the heroes chatted, the Cult of Brood seemed to simply give up, without their Queen they simply didn't have the will or the intellect to fight. As Niles waxed poetic about the future, Beastling, with a dark look on his face, remarked "the promised, glorious future!. Then again, life's just full of surprises, BROOD on that for a while".

As Koriand'ru and Niles battled the Cult of Brood in an attempt to rescue Terra-X, they were quickly overwhelmed, and Niles chose to sacrifice himself by telekinetically forcing Shatterstar fire to safety. The captured Niles Cable was then brought before Brother Brood himself, who boasted that with Niles in his grasp, Zenosha and all of Earth would fall before the Cult of Brood. Implanted with a Brood egg and chained within the tunnels that housed the cult, Niles Cable was confronted by a vision of his dead wife from the far-future, Raveniya the Healer, who offered him a way to escape the infection, a way that would mean certain death. Meanwhile, Brother Brood was officiating over the "Holy Rebirth" of Terra-X into the Cult of Brood, when X-Patrol arrived and battled their way through his followers to the Brood Pit, where the ceremony was taking place. As the heroes confronted Brother Brood, Terra-X, now calling herself Terra-X the Destroyer, emerged from the Brood Pit, fully under Brood control, and viciously attacked them, only to be knocked unconscious by Elasti-Girl, who had shrunken and entered her inner ear. Dial H.U.S.K., in the form of Artemisty Knight, the bionic Amazon Archer, took aim at the cult leader on his perch above the Brood Pit, but was surprised when her arrow struck only an empty cloak, he had draped it across a rock as a distraction, sneaking around to attack the heroes from behind. He boasted that one of their "unbelieving number" had already been "converted", and everyone assumed he was speaking of Niles. Janet attempted to attack Brother Brood, only to be blasted away by an infected Niles Cable. As the team faced defeat, Jericho spoke of a future in which Niles Cable would lead the brood to a brief, and ultimately doomed, victory, cementing humanities hatred for, and persecution of, metamutantkind. Brother Brood then transformed into his Brood Queen form, saying that "when Brood and Metamutant join, both are made more powerful!". In the chaos of battle, Jericho was revealed to be Niles Dayspring, a younger version of Niles Cable himself, and the elder Niles chose to sacrifice himself, freeing the "Soul-Self" of Raveniya he carried within him. Raveniya then enveloped Brother Brood, apparently killing him. Niles' "Techno-Virus" killed the nascent Brood within him, and would have killed him as well, had his younger self not telekinetically forced it into remission. As the heroes chatted, the Cult of Brood seemed to simply give up, without their Queen they simply didn't have the will or the intellect to fight. As Niles waxed poetic about the future, Beastling, with a dark look on his face, remarked "the promised, glorious future!. Then again, life's just full of surprises, BROOD on that for a while".
abilities: Brother Brood was once described as "charismatic".
weapons: He can pull his spines out of his body and use them as weapons

brother staff.name: Brother Staff
brother staff.origin: One of the many sons of the sorcerer and crimelord Zheng Zu, the man known as "Brother Staff" was raised in the House of the Deadly Staff in London, England, eventually becoming its Champion. After his father's death at the supposed hands of his half-brother, Shang-Chi, the title of Supreme Commander of the Five Weapons Society was passed onto Brother Staff. Under his rule, the Society regressed into a "glorified drug ring", prompting his half-sister Sister Hammer to challenge Brother Staff for leadership in a duel to the death. Although Hammer was victorious, Zheng Zu's spirit selected Shang-Chi as the new Supreme Commander. Staff used his last breaths to taunt Hammer, who proceeded to execute him.

weapons: Wields a gun or Chinese staff with a retractable blade that turns it into a quiang or Chinese spear.

broward ollsen.name: Broward Ollsen
broward ollsen.origin: Born in Sweden, Broward "Bo" Ollsen was, by his own choice, a mercenary. Ollsen worked with another mercenary, the former American marine Marc Spector, in several countries at war in the Third World. At some point his career, Ollsen worked in Iran, and was wounded in an activity called Operation Sundown. Along with other international mercenaries including Spector, Ollsen was recruited by Emmanuel Raposa for his revolutionary movement, Raposistas, which sought to violently take power in the Latin American nation Bosqueverde. Raposa was generously paying his mercenaries to participate in the assault on the capital, Ciudad Leando. Raposa informed Ollsen that he had reached an agreement with President Ricardo Dominguez for Dominguez to legitimize Raposa's takeover and never challenge him, in exchange for one million U.S. dollars in gold krugerrands that Raposa had already delivered to Dominguez. However, Raposa had decided to assassinate Dominguez to recover the gold, and gave orders in person to Ollsen to take care of it during the assault. The rest of the mercenaries were not informed, to avoid leaks, and instead they just received orders to capture Dominguez alive. During Raposa's siege of Ciudad Leando in the summer, the unit led by Ollsen traversed the streets on their way to the Presidential Palace; the raid lasted almost an entire day, and all of Ollsen's men were killed in the operation except Spector. Ollsen and Spector reached the President's office, finding Dominguez and his wife Carmilla packing to leave. Dominguez mistakenly believed Ollsen and Spector had been sent by Raposa to escort them to a plane to fly to Europe, even if Ollsen and Spector were aiming their weapons at him. Ollsen noticed that Dominguez was shaking in fear. Dominguez reached into a drawer in his desk to get the key to the safebox where he had kept the gold. Ollsen saw the opportunity to justify the murder of Dominguez while benefiting himself, without even getting his hands personally dirty: Ollsen yelled at Spector that Dominguez was trying to get a gun, so Spector fired a 9-millimeter burst, killing the president in what he believed was self-defense; Ollsen did not doubt that the ex-Marine would react in such a violent and obedient. Ollsen then had Spector leave the room to go outside to get a smoke and report to Raposa that Dominguez was dead, while Ollsen busied himself "cleaning up" the mess. Spector saw Ollsen talking to the woman, but did not hear what they said. Ollsen, unlike Spector, had recognized the woman as Dominguez's wife. He told her that he knew about the gold that Raposa had given to her husband, but that in that situation, Ollsen could choose between giving Señora Dominguez to Raposa as a political prisoner; or, if Señora Dominguez could use that key to access the gold, she could share it with Ollsen, without Raposa knowing about it. Señora Dominguez agreed to conspire with Ollsen to survive as a rich woman and escape the country, and told him that the strongbox was in a wine cellar in the Palace. Ollsen smuggled the gold under Raposa's nose, not without difficulty, and was then able to spend his share. Señora Dominguez claimed that the two mercenaries had forgiven her, and after that coup, Raposa took power in Bosqueverde, proving to be a monstrous butcher during his almost ten years in office. After that operation, Ollsen continued his mercenary work, although he eventually stopped collaborating with Spector, and began working as a secret agent for the United States government and as a member of Delta Force, to destroy the criminal group Secret Empire by infiltrating their ranks, using the aliases Laird Donnelson and Jack Starr. He became a member of a mercenary force hired by the Secret Empire to attack the capital of an independent island nation south of Java; but the mercenary team was sent to his death because their employer, Number One, lied to them and abandoned them. Ollsen survived and went to prison for five years; the rest of his people had died when he was released. Ollsen was enraged and eager for revenge, but unable to find the conspirators by himself. He did find an Empire-funded racist paramilitary group Praetorian Brotherhood, and infiltrated them in search of those responsible for his misfortune, operating in New York City. Ollsen's activities attracted the attention of the law enforcement agency S.H.I.E.L.D., which opened a file on him as a member of the Praetorians. Ten years after the attack on Ciudad Leando, Bosqueverde's government changed and Raposa left the country, knowing that the new government would seek to punish the crimes of his regime. Bosqueverde was unable to find Raposa, although Ollsen discovered that Raposa was in Miami, leading a group of criminals who carried cocaine to Florida. fields.notes: Ollsen's S.H.I.E.L.D. file seen in (1990) says that he was in Iran in 1978; the date is now a topical reference. It also mentions he was wounded in Operation Sundown, which is surely not the Operation Sundown from the real world (which was only declassified in 2014); and that he was a member of a team called Delta Force, which is more likely the United States Army Special Forces and not the Delta Force made up of Deviants seen in - .
fields.trivia: During the operation to kill Dominguez, Spector believed that Ollsen and himself had arrived before the other members of their unit, but Ollsen confirmed that, at that point, the two of them were the only surviving members of the unit.

brown toad.name: Brown Toad
brown toad.origin: Preface: Many stories about the American Frontier were adapted into dime store novels that were adapted on actual events, including those tales of famous heroes of the American Frontier . As such the history of Red Hawk should be questioned as many of the facts contradict actual historical events. According to accounts, Brown Toad was a warrior in the Apache Tribe led by Red Hawk. Brown Toad has aspirations to be the new chief after Red Hawk died and also relished the ongoing war between the white settlers in the area and his people. Brown Toad joined an attack on a wagon train, killing all those in his path including the mother of Alan Krandal, when she covered the escape of her child and friends. Red Hawk and Brown Toad caught up with Krandal and Brown Toad was about to slaughter the boy when Red Hawk became impressed with the boys bravery in the face of death and ordered Brown Toad to stand down. Red Hawk decided to take the boy into the tribe and raised him as an Apache warrior in the hopes of using him as a spy against white men in the future. Brown Toad was against this idea, and soon the boy -- renamed the Apache Kid -- came to excel at all Apache trades to the point where Red Hawk began considering Apache Kid to be his successor. This angered Brown Toad who began plotting with a gun dealer named Fannin on how to eliminate the Apache Kid. This came after a slaughter of people in their village which led to the Apache Kid adopting his alter-ego of roving cowboy Aloysius Kare to infiltrate nearby Fort Madison to learn when the Army was planning to attack their village. Brown Toad and Fannin tip off the military hoping to incite a war that would see Red Hawk dead so that Brown Toad could take over leadership of the tribe. However, the Apache Kid managed to escape Fort Madison and started a massive grass fire to keep the military at bay while the Apache village retreated. Brown Toad and Fannin watched from the tall grass to see the battle and ended up becoming the only victims that day when they were trapped in the grass fire and burned alive.
weapons: Brown Toad had access to common Apache weapons such as knives, and hunting rifles.

browning.name: Browning
browning.origin: Browning was a mutant mechanic. He was hired by the mutant carnival host Denham to fix "Metallak", Denham's star attraction. Unfortunately for both mutants, Metallak was actually a Sentinel, and Browning's repairs reverted it to its true programming. The Sentinel obliterated Browning where he stood.

bruce bravelle.name: Bruce Bravelle
bruce bravelle.origin: Bruce Bravelle had agreed to be a test subject for Professor Davis, who was trying to find a way to nourish the human body using electrical currents as a substitute for food. In the middle of one of the tests, a bolt of lightning strikes the castle, causing an opposing magnetic flow. Afterwards, Bruce discovers he can spin around like a top when he crosses his wrists (or is exposed to electricity). Davis dubbed Bruce The Top and told him he should use his powers to fight crime and help the innocent. In his first recorded adventure as the Human Top, Bravelle would stop a bunch of bank robbers from fleeing the police. Taking the money back to National Bank owner Horace Vanderveer. Unaware that Vanderveer was behind the robbery, the Human Top would be shocked to find when he is later framed for the robbery. Tracking Vanderveer to his yacht, the Human Top would then easily defeat his minions and use his spinning powers to force Horace into confessing his crimes. thumb|102px|Alternate costume After weeks of inactivity, the Human Top would hear a radio call regarding a train crash and spin off to rescue the injured passengers. Arriving at the scene, the Human Top learned that the train was being robbed by a masked criminal calling himself the Red Terror. Using his powers, the Top forced the Red Terror to flee in his zeppelin. After rescuing the trapped passengers, the Human Top would follow the Red Terror to his hideout in an abandoned mine. After the Top fought through all the mines defenses, the Red Terror attempted to flee in his zeppelin once more. The Top would wreck the zeppelin before it could get away, sending the Red Terror falling to his death.

bruce carmody.origin: Bruce was the son of Carmody the Pirate who at his death declared that Bruce was too wicked even to share a treasure of a buccaneer, then disinherited him leaving everything to his younger son Joe. To regain all the treasure, Bruce turned to a sorcerer and after a lavish reward he would get him a potion; as soon as his brother had taken the potion he would have had visions of his father that would bring him to the treasure. To make Joe drink the potion, the two devised a plan that consisted of inviting Bruce and Joe to the sorcerer's house where the sorcerer's daughter would also be, a very handsome girl named Laurie who would make Joe drink the potion, but the girl just saw Joe really fell in love with him and instead deceived Bruce to drink the potion. For the next seven years, Bruce set out in on a wild goose chase searching a treasure that was not guided by visions, until he returned to America and discovered that the treasure had always been in the hands of his brother, who in the meantime had also married Laurie and even accepting in his home even the sorcerer father-in-law.

bruce harris.name: Bruce Harris
bruce harris.origin: Bruce Harris was a famous rock singer who hired Dazzler as the warm-up number of his concerts. When Harris showed up to her, he did it in an extremely arrogant way by telling her that the audience was there for him and if they showed themselves hostile to her, she remembered that she was being paid (thou not a lot of money and with delays). After the first concerts in the west coast tour, however, the audience shifted their preferences towards Dazzler, and Harris thought that his warm-up should not compete with him, admitting that she was very good; after performing at the Cow Palace in San Francisco in front of 17,000 people, the San Francisco Chronicle praised her performance as his opening act making it look like she, not he, had been the star, and indeed some fans changed their support signs during the concert. With the rise of Dazzler's success, Harris and his manager dismissed Dazzler to prevent her from continuing to steal the stage just before they performed in Seattle's Kingdome - but Dazzler did not lose heart, again outstaged Harris even knowing she had just been fired, and ironically thanked him, wishing that the next warm-up would not steal his thunder and suggesting him to hire Alvin and the Chipmunks for that job. Years later, no longer a rock star but a simple waiter, Harris was interviewed about Dazzler's career and still resenting he said he was forced to get rid of her because his opening show was a joke.

bruno.name: Bruno
bruno.origin: One of the several minions of the so-called Master of Freaks, who appared to be hideous, Bruno served as his majordomo and followed the Master's policies without discussion - including the one about destroying beauty. Bruno and other "freaks" helped guiding Frankenstein's Monster to the Master's lair to recruit him - but the Monster refused and was chained to the dungeons. Bruno then helped kidnapping Julia Winters, a woman who had rejected the Master's romantic approach. Bruno was disgruntled at having to tie Julia for the Master to torture her. When the Master revealed his real face to Julia, Bruno and the other freaks discovered that the Master was handsome. Bruno then tried to stop the Master from hurting Julia with a torch, but the Master reacting by burning Bruno to death - something that the other freaks disliked. The freaks united against the Master and killed him, while Frankenstein's Monster escaped with Julia.

bruno beitz.name: Bruno Beitz
bruno beitz.origin: Bruno Beitz was a Nazi spy who was active during World War II. By the winter of 1943 he was operating in the United States collecting information on American shipping routes with the aid of his agent Baroness von Kampf, whom he protected with a pair of guard dogs. However when a local gossip column began questioning von Kampf's refugee status, Beitz demanded that she get him any remaining information at once. Beitz was unimpressed to learn that she needed money to get it from a middle man named Miguel Rico, but gave her the cash regardless. The exchange went awry thanks to the interference of Miss Fury, who subsequently attacked the Baroness when she tried to steal clothes from her apartment. During the altercation, one of the Baroness' dogs was killed by Rico. When Beitz learned of the dog's death, the Baroness covered up her encounter with Rico saying the dog had attacked her and she was forced to shoot it. The two then began conspiring to eliminate South American ambassador Filipe Santos. They got their break a few days prior to Santos' arrival in America. Due to the fact that Marla had stashed her Miss Fury costume in a flower planter on the Baroness' balcony she sent her door man, Cappy, and her cat, Peri Purr, to recover the costume, using the 'runaway' cat as a reason to search the balcony. However, when the feline was thrown onto the balcony, Beitz grabbed the Peri Purr, making it look as though the Baroness' remaining attack dog had killed the feline. Beitz then attached an acid-triggered explosive to the cat and brought it to the airport Santos was due to arrive at. There, he waited with one of his fellow spies for the diplomat to arrive. After one of his agents sprayed Santos with a scent that would attract the Peri Purr, it came to him as he was greeting the press on the runway. As luck would have it Marla Drake and her fiancée, Gary Hale, were at the airport and recognized the cat. Calling her cat back, Marla and Gary found the bomb. Not knowing what the bomb was, Gary tossed it over the fence between two parked cars. One of the cars happened to be the one that Bruno was waiting in. Seeing the bomb being thrown, Bruno attempted to flee the scene but was caught in the explosion, costing him his arm.
weapons: Bruno used a pistol. He also had access to explosive tubes that were triggered by acid.

bruno grainger.name: Bruno Grainger
bruno grainger.origin: ===Early years=== Bruno Grainger was an helicopter pilot for the U.S. Army, and a Bagram heavyweight champion. left|thumb|Bruno taking down fellow soldiers Grainger had a "problem with authority", and was involved in at least a brawl while in Afghanistan involving military personnel, which presumably led him to quit the Army, one way or another. ===Criminal=== During her early criminal days, Black Cat recruited Bruno Grainger and Dr. Boris Korpse as her first crew for her first big job: breaking her father, Walter Hardy, out of jail. His conflict with authority disappeared in her employ. During that time, Grainger came into conflict with the hero Spider-Man. Bruno and Dr. Korpse later joined the Black Cat in the heist of a painting from the Frick Collection. Acting as waiters, Bruno and Korpse ended up stealing one of the paintings while Felicia acted as the bait because of her history the security were focused more on her then anyone else. Boris drove Felicia's car after she was escorted off the premises. As Bruno and the others made their getaway, they were attacked by the Thieves Guild who wanted to steal the painting for themselves. They managed to escape due to the untimely appearance of security guard Sonny Ocampo. Back at the hideout, Black Cat proposed her crew distance themselves from her due to the Guild's actions, but they both refused. The crew was surprised by the mysterious buyer, who managed to evade all security measures and entered the hideout, revealing himself as the Black Fox, the man who had taught both Black Cat and her father about the arts of robbery.
abilities: Boxing: Grainger was a skilled , and was a heavyweight champion at Bagram. : An ex-Army helicopter pilot, Grainger was stated to be able to pilot anything with wheels or blades.

bruno karnelli.name: Bruno Karnelli
bruno karnelli.origin: Bruno Karnelli was the self-proclaimed heir apparent of the two Maggia families, the Karnellis and the Manfredis, since the marriage of his parents had united the two factions. Despite his status, he was shunned from the Maggia's activities for his lousy behavior. Because of this, he allied himself with fledgling mob boss Mister Negative in hopes to rise to the top, unaware that Negative only intended to use him. While hanging out at the Blind Spot, Karnelli was accidentally marked with a Spider-Tracer by Sean Boyle, a mugger who had stolen one of Spider-Man's Web-Shooters. After leaving the bar, Karnelli was kidnapped by Mister Negative's Inner Demons and brought to a secret medical facility where Mister Negative strapped Bruno to a pumping device that extracted his blood in order to brew a version of the poisonous Devil's Breath that was encoded to both sides of his family. Spider-Man interrupted the procedure since his spider-sense had picked up the tracer on Karnelli. Before escaping, Negative configured the pumps to extract all of Karnelli's blood to distract the hero. Spider-Man managed to save Karnelli, and he informed him about a meeting between the two families taking place at the Vandemere Hotel that Mister Negative was going to target. Following the death of every adult male in the Maggia at the hands of Devil's Breath, Bruno took over operations, but his management was disastruous and the Maggia lost most of its influence. As a result, Carmine Karnelli hired Mysterio to orchestrate the apparent return of several dead Maggia higher-ups, including legendary Maggia leader Silvermane, and Bruno handed control over to them.

bruno markham.name: Bruno Markham
bruno markham.origin: Bruno Markham was the owner of the Markham Machine Company who learned of Ernesto Mendez's invention: a valve that would revolutionize engines by reducing fuel consumption and pollution. He initially tried to acquire the discovery by offering Mendez a lot of money, but Mendez was an idealist and preferred to make his discovery known to the world, so Markham took the hard way by having Mendez beaten to death and kidnapping his nephew Pablo. Venom went to Markham's factory to avenge Mendez's death and when he found him, Markham was convinced that he was there to arrest him, so he burned the only blueprint of Mendez's discovery, convinced that with no proof they could not condemn him, ignorant of Venom's nature. He cared not for Mendez's arrest but for his death, which he caused immediately by throwing him into a vat of molten metal.

bruno storme.name: Bruno Storme
bruno storme.origin: Bruno Storme was a hunter who trafficked in weapons with the indigenous people of Congo. He tried to capture a large ape with four arms so he could sell it and earn a large sum. Shorty Harris, a reporter and animal lover who went to the Congo to investigate arms trafficking, heard Storme's intentions and ran to the Beast's aid, saving him from capture. Soon after, Shorty was captured by the natives and held prisoner in their village to be handed over to the hunter who sold him the weapons, the same hunter who wanted to capture the Beast. Recognizing Shorty as the one who had prevented the capture of the Beast, he ordered the natives to eliminate him, but the Beast came to Shorty's aid, who revealed himself to be a powerful alien and easily defeated the natives and transformed Storme into insubstantial vapor.

bruno varoz.name: Bruno Varoz
bruno varoz.origin: thumb|left|Varoz's army of the undead Mad genius Dr. Bruno Varoz operated out of a castle on his private island off the coast of Cuba. He was a scientific genius who constructed many death traps and created scientific monstrosities, including a two headed beast. He eventually perfected a form of synthetic blood that allowed him to reanimated the dead and force the corpses to do his bidding. With the aid of his minion, the hunchback named Miguel, Dr. Varoz collected an army of the undead and unleashed them on the United States, ordering them to loot major cities such as New York City and Los Angeles and murder anyone who got in their way. The authorities were unable to stop the creatures and the President of the United States asked Professor Zog to use his Electro robot to stop the menace. As Electro smashed the undead creatures, Dr. Varoz sent his two headed beast to capture Electro and bring the robot back to his island. He dumped the robot in a vat of acid and considered it destroyed. However, Professor Zog increased the robot's remote power source, allowing it to escape. Varoz again failed to stop Electro when his "Chamber of Death" proved ineffectual against the robot as well. Electro grabbed Varoz and tossed him into the vat of acid, killing him. Varoz's castle then was destroyed by an air raid, and Electro returned to America to crush the remaining undead forces that Varoz commanded.
powers: thumb|Varoz's two-headed beast

These two would meet again and battle in the streets of New York when Brushfire melts a cop car. Gravity, with permission from his girlfriend, uses his powers to drop a car on top of Brushfire.
