fields.occupation: Chief of security at GARID Laboratories
fields.history: Attending were Bill Galannan and his partner Eric Schwinner, Calvin Falconer the head of security, and their recent hired, Peter Parker. Thanks to their insider knowledge and Falconer's past experience as a SHIELD agent, they had been able to confirm that the serial killer loose in the city was indeed River Verys, their former patient. Calvin also had determined a pattern based on the victims that he as killed so far. He suggested that they capture and contain River on their own since the authorities would just ask for GAIRD's assistance in curing him. This would stop the killer, as well as protect GARID from any fallout. Inside, Calvin Falconer reminded his men that when they found Tendril, they were to take the killer in alive, no matter what. Back at GARID, Calvin Falconer was furious that the press had arrived during his hunt for Tendril. He knew that they were tipped off by Bill Galannan and demanded to know how the scientist figured out that Tendril could be found at the Steel Bridge. Bill explained that River Verys' criminal record showed that Verys was once arrested for armed robbery on that bridge. Bill told Calvin that, had he done his job right, they could have spun the media presence to the benefit of GARID Labs. Peter Parker realized that he was running late for an appointment with Calvin Falconer. The pair were going to go out and visit Paul Contoni, a previous patient of the late Doctor Monica Staphos, a man who might hold the key to curing Tendril of his condition. Peter Parker and Calvin Falconer -- GARID's head of security and a former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent -- arrived at the home of Paul Contoni. Contoni, who suffered from a horrifying skin disease told both men to go away, even though he knew why they had come he had no interest in helping them catch Tendril. Falconer was about to go back into his jeep to get his tranquilizer gun but Peter stopped him. Parker pointed out that after everything Contoni had endured, he had every right to privacy and to shut the outside world out of his life. Although Calvin thought this whole trip was a waste, Peter had already decided to pay Paul a visit later, as Spider-Man.

calvin felder.name: Calvin Felder
calvin felder.origin: Timothy Braverman had been a successful criminal mastermind in Los Angeles, planning crimes for others for money from his underground lair in the Situation Room, until, in his civilian identity, he began a romance with the superheroine Spider-Woman that culminated in Braverman's arrest. Calvin Felder then took over the Gamesman identity, as well as his other assets, including the Situation Room, the high-tech weapons used by Braverman's men, and his network of contacts (among them Marsha, the cleaner at the Los Angeles Police Headquarters who would phone the Gamesman in to report on events at the station). Felder had heard that Braverman had hidden a stash of ten million prior to his capture, but didn't know where, so he developed an elaborate plan to find the money by kidnapping Spider-Woman for interrogation and, if she didn't know about the money, having an artist, Fritzy, take down every detail of Spider-Woman's costume and body to create an impersonator that would fool Braverman into leading them to the loot. Several of Felder's men (Ferdie, Stevie, and others) ambushed Spider-Woman when she left the jail to visit Braverman, but she stood up to them and put them to flight. When the Gamesman's guns proved useless due to her powers, Stevie fired a lead bullet at Spider-Woman, allowing them to escape. Felder was angry that they wouldn't get what they needed, but he came up with a new plan. When Marsha informed the Gamesman that Spider-Woman was in the precinct, Felder's men, including Stevie, ambushed Spider-Woman on her way out. Using a knockout gas, they knocked her unconscious and took her to a Doomsday Room, an electrified, explosive death trap, where they chained her to a pillar. Felder interrogated Spider-Woman about Braverman's hidden loot, but she knew nothing about it; Stevie offered to torture Spider-Woman, which Felder refused. During the interrogation, Fritzie took down every detail about her. Satisfied, Felder left her in the Doomsday Room, telling her that the column she was tied to would explode within a minute and that all metal surfaces were lethally electrified, not to mention the effects of the gas. Spider-Woman however used her superhuman strength to break the column and used it as a pole to escape through a small glass window, making the most of her slender figure and her agility. Felder and his men mistakenly believed her to be dead. Felder procured a Spider-Woman costume, and hired actress Lindsay McCabe to impersonate Spider-Woman in an attempt to trace the stolen loot, for which Felder pretended to be an FBI agent and offered her a lot of money, enough to support McCabe for month. Spider-Woman, in her secret identity as Jessica Drew, was a close friend of McCabe, and deduced the Gamesman's plan. As Spider-Woman, she spoke to McCabe to explain that her supposed employers were criminals who would likely kill her after the operation, and instead they worked together to have the real Spider-Woman impersonate McCabe by posing as Spider-Woman, following Felder's plan to catch him off guard. Spider-Woman secretly collaborated with LAPD Captain Alexander Walsh to have the police follow her to Felder's lair in order to apprehend him. Spider-Woman helped Braverman break out of prison, and Braverman took her to the Los Angeles Bank and Trust Company to remove ten million dollars' worth of diamonds from a safety deposit vault. Felder's men ambushed them at the exit and bundled them into a car, taking them to Felder's lair. Braverman asked Spider-Woman to use her powers to help them, and then Felder unmasked Spider-Woman, revealing McCabe's face. Spider-Woman then revealed her true identity, catching Felder and his men by surprise. She defeated them single-handed and captured them, leaving them in the hands of Captain Walsh and his men. Braverman was also arrested and returned to prison.
abilities: He showed some skill as a criminal mastermind and leader.

calvin langstrom.name: Calvin Langstrom
calvin langstrom.origin: While attending Columbia, Elektra earned the enmity of the privileged Calvin Langstrom after she humiliated him while defending a woman he was bothering. Things between Elektra and Langstrom continued to escalate with him raping her friend Melissa Beckerman and hiring criminals to burn down her father's home and business. When Langstrom attempted to attack Melissa once again, Elektra lured him into an attempt against her life so she could instead kill him as he continued to face no punishment from his crimes thanks to his wealthy and politically connected father. Elektra was stopped by Matt who revealed his powers and vigilantism to her. Elektra chose to cut one of Langstrom's arteries and told Matt he could either let him bleed out and come with her or save his life. Matt chose to save Langstrom and the two parted with Elektra also dropping her classes.

Calvin elected to be behavior modified by the Squadron Supreme in order to attain a full pardon for his crimes and the procedure was performed on him by Hyperion and Arcanna. Calvin was very nervous about the procedure, but afterwards his personality was completely changed and he was very happy.

cambria banner.name: Cambria Banner
cambria banner.origin: Cambria was one of Pappy Hulk's children. Finished with her father's cruelty, she escaped from him. Initially, Cambria was stealing pigs from Logan farm to survive, but that stopped when Logan and Hawkeye caught her. Hawkeye wanted to kill her, but Logan spared her on the condition that she would stop stealing from him. Later she was among the Hulks' offspring gathered by Maestro and transported to the Prime Marvel Universe. Unlike the others, she didn't support Maestro's violent plan and turned on him, helping Logan and the Hawkeye of this Earth stop Maestro after they promised to spare the youngest Hulks. After the defeated Maestro escaped, she rejected Clint's offer of help and left along with the children to find their own life.

camden leung.name: Camden Leung
camden leung.origin: At the docks, Marty Siu prepares to torture "Charlie", who is revealed to be former Chinese Army Colonel Camden Leung, with a blowtorch but stops when Leung challenges to face him like a man. Siu beats him badly and prepares to resume his original plan when Leung pleads for mercy and that he can lead him to the Golden Buddha. Punisher and the Cobras arrive at a dock warehouse where Fong takes out the guard with a ninja star. Once inside, a gunfight breaks out between the two groups as Duc recognizes Leung as the man who killed his father alongside the North Vietnamese army. Leung takes Siu's gun and leads the Tigers in a flanking manuever around the building, which Punisher saw coming and repositioned the Cobras to ambush them. Siu is among those gunned down but Leung keeps shooting. Punisher disables him from behind and tries to convince him to help him and therefore help Li Pung. Before Leung can respond, Duc shoots him. Punisher slugs him but Duc has already fulfilled his blood oath.

camellia.name: Camellia
camellia.origin: Camellia is the sister of the Chameleon and a shape-shifting thief/murderer. Unlike her brother, Camellia was only heard via telephone conversations with her brother. When her brother brought J. Jonah Jameson and Peter Parker, who had been drugged with a substance that temporarily nullifies his powers, Camellia stepped out into the light and revealed to them her favored form: A mannequin-esque faceless young woman with a curvy hourglass-shaped body wearing revealing clothes. Upon seeing her, Jonah demanded to know what she wanted from him and Peter and were to be given an explanation. However, as she changed her face to that of Jonah's, she told him that this was about Peter now and that Jonah himself was no longer a factor in her and her brother's plans to obtain everything they have ever wanted. Then using her golden pistol, she shot Jonah point blank in the head and pushed the chair he was strapped to over while altering her face to look like Peter's and began the process of mentally torturing Peter by filling his head with the idea of her brother bringing physical harm to Gwen Stacy and how the stress of seeing "Peter" harm Gwen would affect. With that image and the images of the repercussions of such a horrific event set in Peter's mind, he became hysterical. She proceeded to smash her pistol over his head, knocking him unconscious. It was not long after that her brother came crashing into their hideout screaming that they needed to kill Peter as quickly as possible and make a run for it. However, when Chameleon tried to kill Peter, the drugs he had been given wore off and gave Peter enough power to dodge the bullet, break free of his bindings and attack Chameleon. Chameleon then stunned Peter with an electrical energy blast and demanded that Camellia give him another gun but instead of doing so, she protested against killing Parker and demanded that they make their escape before it was too late. Camellia quickly realized that the temperature in their hideout was going down rather quickly and came to the conclusion that the Human Torch and Iceman had managed to find and follow her brother back to his hideout. But before they could escape, an impenetrable wall of ice cut off all their escape routes and marked the arrival of Peter's friends and fellow super-heroes. Camellia chastised her brother for becoming too greedy, which she believed allowed this to happen but before she could finish chastising him, she was sucked down into the ice and sealed away in a human sized, life-sustaining ice cube of Iceman's own making. She was later taken to The Triskelion with her brother but was placed in a separate cell somewhere else in the detention cell units.
powers: Lady Chameleon is a . She's able to take the form of any human by looking into their eyes, her body will then morph in the exact dimensions of the person she copied. Copying a person's form does not grant her any new abilities.
